    order_items = db['order_items'].copy()
    reviews = db['reviews'].copy()
    payments = db['payments'].copy()

    # --- Фильтрация событий до seed_time ---
    # Заказы (по моменту покупки)
    orders_past = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]
    # Позиции заказов, принадлежащие прошедшим заказам
    items_past = order_items[order_items['order_id'].isin(orders_past['order_id'])]

        # Если нет истории, возвращаем нулевой DataFrame
        features_df = pd.DataFrame(0, index=entity_ids, columns=[])
        return features_df

    items_past = items_past.merge(orders_past[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'customer_id']],
                                  on='order_id', how='left')

    price_agg = items_past.groupby('product_id').agg(

        n_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),

        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        mean_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),

    order_dates['days_since_last_order'] = (seed_time - order_dates['max']).dt.days

        features['days_since_first_order'] = order_dates_idx['days_since_first_order']
        features['days_since_last_order'] = order_dates_idx['days_since_last_order']

    # Скорость

        features['n_orders_30'] = count_30
    if not count_90.empty:
        features['n_orders_90'] = count_90

                features[col] = review_agg_idx[col]

    # Платежи
    if not pay_agg.empty:
        pay_agg_idx = pay_agg.set_index('product_id')
        for col in ['mean_n_payments', 'mean_installments', 'mean_payment_value']:
            if col in pay_agg_idx.columns:
                features[col] = pay_agg_idx[col]

    if features:
        df = pd.DataFrame(features)

        df = pd.DataFrame(0, index=entity_ids, columns=[])

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders'].copy()
    order_items = db['order_items'].copy()
    reviews = db['reviews'].copy()
    payments = db['payments'].copy()

    # Фильтруем order_items по времени покупки (ts) до seed_time
    items = order_items[order_items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    # Оставляем только интересующие товары
    items = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)]

    # Если нет данных, сразу возвращаем DataFrame с нулями
    if items.empty:
        # Создаём пустой DataFrame с нужными столбцами и индексами
        cols = [
            'count_orders', 'count_items', 'sum_price', 'avg_price',
            'sum_freight', 'avg_freight', 'days_since_last_purchase',
            'days_since_first_purchase', 'has_purchase',
            'count_orders_7', 'count_items_7', 'sum_price_7',
            'count_orders_30', 'count_items_30', 'sum_price_30',
            'count_orders_90', 'count_items_90', 'sum_price_90',
            'count_orders_180', 'count_items_180', 'sum_price_180',
            'avg_review_score', 'count_reviewed_orders',
            'positive_reviews', 'total_reviews_with_score',
            'avg_total_payment', 'avg_num_payments', 'avg_credit_card_share',
            'total_orders_with_payment',
            'delivered', 'canceled', 'other_status',
            'count_sellers'
        ]
        return pd.DataFrame(0, index=entity_ids, columns=cols)

    # Базовые агрегации по всем данным
    base_agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
        count_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        count_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        sum_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        max_ts=('ts', 'max'),
        min_ts=('ts', 'min'),
        count_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()

    # Временные признаки
    base_agg['days_since_last_purchase'] = (seed_time - base_agg['max_ts']).dt.days
    base_agg['days_since_first_purchase'] = (seed_time - base_agg['min_ts']).dt.days
    base_agg['has_purchase'] = 1

    # Агрегации по временным окнам
    windows = [7, 30, 90, 180]
    for w in windows:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        mask = items['ts'] > cutoff
        items_w = items[mask]
        if items_w.empty:
            # Если нет данных в окне, добавляем нулевые столбцы
            base_agg[f'count_orders_{w}'] = 0
            base_agg[f'count_items_{w}'] = 0
            base_agg[f'sum_price_{w}'] = 0.0
        else:
            agg_w = items_w.groupby('product_id').agg(
                count_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
                count_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
                sum_price=('price', 'sum')
            ).reset_index()
            agg_w.columns = ['product_id', f'count_orders_{w}', f'count_items_{w}', f'sum_price_{w}']
            base_agg = base_agg.merge(agg_w, on='product_id', how='left')

    # Признаки на основе отзывов
    # Объединяем items с reviews по order_id
    items_reviews = items.merge(reviews[['order_id', 'review_score']], on='order_id', how='left')
    # Только строки с оценкой
    items_reviews_notna = items_reviews[items_reviews['review_score'].notna()]
    if not items_reviews_notna.empty:
        review_agg = items_reviews_notna.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            count_reviewed_orders=('order_id', 'nunique')
        ).reset_index()
        # Доля положительных отзывов
        items_reviews_notna['positive'] = (items_reviews_notna['review_score'] >= 4).astype(int)
        pos_agg = items_reviews_notna.groupby('product_id')['positive'].agg(['sum', 'count']).reset_index()
        pos_agg.columns = ['product_id', 'positive_reviews', 'total_reviews_with_score']
        review_agg = review_agg.merge(pos_agg, on='product_id', how='outer')
        base_agg = base_agg.merge(review_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    else:
        # Если нет отзывов, добавляем нулевые столбцы
        base_agg['avg_review_score'] = 0
        base_agg['count_reviewed_orders'] = 0
        base_agg['positive_reviews'] = 0
        base_agg['total_reviews_with_score'] = 0

    # Признаки на основе платежей
    # Агрегируем платежи по заказам
    payments_agg = payments.groupby('order_id')['payment_value'].sum().rename('total_payment').reset_index()
    payments_agg['num_payments'] = payments.groupby('order_id')['payment_sequential'].count().values
    credit = payments[payments['payment_type'] == 'credit_card'].groupby('order_id')['payment_value'].sum().rename('credit_card_value')
    payments_agg = payments_agg.merge(credit, on='order_id', how='left')
    payments_agg['credit_card_value'] = payments_agg['credit_card_value'].fillna(0)
    payments_agg['credit_card_share'] = payments_agg['credit_card_value'] / payments_agg['total_payment']

    # Уникальные пары (product_id, order_id)
    unique_orders = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
    unique_orders_pay = unique_orders.merge(payments_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    if not unique_orders_pay.empty:
        pay_agg = unique_orders_pay.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_total_payment=('total_payment', 'mean'),
            avg_num_payments=('num_payments', 'mean'),
            avg_credit_card_share=('credit_card_share', 'mean'),
            total_orders_with_payment=('order_id', 'nunique')
        ).reset_index()
        base_agg = base_agg.merge(pay_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    else:
        base_agg['avg_total_payment'] = 0
        base_agg['avg_num_payments'] = 0
        base_agg['avg_credit_card_share'] = 0
        base_agg['total_orders_with_payment'] = 0

    # Признаки на основе статусов заказов
    unique_orders_all = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
    orders_status = orders[['order_id', 'order_status']]
    status_data = unique_orders_all.merge(orders_status, on='order_id', how='left')
    # Считаем количество каждого статуса
    status_counts = status_data.groupby(['product_id', 'order_status']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    status_counts = status_counts.reset_index().rename_axis(None, axis=1)
    # Добавляем столбцы delivered, canceled, other
    if 'delivered' not in status_counts.columns:
        status_counts['delivered'] = 0
    if 'canceled' not in status_counts.columns:
        status_counts['canceled'] = 0
    # Остальные статусы объединяем в other
    other_cols = [c for c in status_counts.columns if c not in ['product_id', 'delivered', 'canceled']]
    if other_cols:
        status_counts['other_status'] = status_counts[other_cols].sum(axis=1)
        status_counts = status_counts[['product_id', 'delivered', 'canceled', 'other_status']]
    else:
        status_counts['other_status'] = 0
    base_agg = base_agg.merge(status_counts, on='product_id', how='left')

    # Устанавливаем индекс product_id
    base_agg = base_agg.set_index('product_id')

    # Переиндексируем под все entity_ids, заполняя пропуски нулями
    result = base_agg.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)

    # Заполняем оставшиеся NaN нулями
    result = result.fillna(0)

    # Убеждаемся, что все столбцы числовые
    for col in result.columns:
        result[col] = pd.to_numeric(result[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0)

    return result

    else:

        base_agg['avg_review_score'] = 0
        base_agg['count_reviewed_orders'] = 0
        base_agg['positive_reviews'] = 0
        base_agg['total_reviews_with_score'] = 0

    # Признаки на основе платежей

    payments_agg = payments.groupby('order_id')['payment_value'].sum().rename('total_payment').reset_index()

    payments_agg['credit_card_value'] = payments_agg['credit_card_value'].fillna(0)
    payments_agg['credit_card_share'] = payments_agg['credit_card_value'] / payments_agg['total_payment']

    # Уникальные пары (product_id, order_id)
    unique_orders = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()

    if not unique_orders_pay.empty:
        pay_agg = unique_orders_pay.groupby('product_id').agg(

            avg_num_payments=('num_payments', 'mean'),
            avg_credit_card_share=('credit_card_share', 'mean'),
            total_orders_with_payment=('order_id', 'nunique')

        base_agg = base_agg.merge(pay_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    else:

        base_agg['avg_num_payments'] = 0
        base_agg['avg_credit_card_share'] = 0
        base_agg['total_orders_with_payment'] = 0

    unique_orders_all = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
    orders_status = orders[['order_id', 'order_status']]
    status_data = unique_orders_all.merge(orders_status, on='order_id', how='left')
    # Считаем количество каждого статуса
    status_counts = status_data.groupby(['product_id', 'order_status']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    status_counts = status_counts.reset_index().rename_axis(None, axis=1)
    # Добавляем столбцы delivered, canceled, other
    if 'delivered' not in status_counts.columns:
        status_counts['delivered'] = 0
    if 'canceled' not in status_counts.columns:
        status_counts['canceled'] = 0
    # Остальные статусы объединяем в other
    other_cols = [c for c in status_counts.columns if c not in ['product_id', 'delivered', 'canceled']]
    if other_cols:
        status_counts['other_status'] = status_counts[other_cols].sum(axis=1)
        status_counts = status_counts[['product_id', 'delivered', 'canceled', 'other_status']]
    else:
        status_counts['other_status'] = 0
    base_agg = base_agg.merge(status_counts, on='product_id', how='left')

    # Устанавливаем индекс product_id
    base_agg = base_agg.set_index('product_id')

    result = base_agg.reindex(entity_ids, fill_value=0)

    for col in result.columns:

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    import numpy as np

    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # ensure seed_time is Timestamp
    if not isinstance(seed_time, pd.Timestamp):
        seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    # Merge order_items with orders to get purchase dates and delivery info
    merged = order_items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_delivered_customer_date']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    )
    merged = merged[merged['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time].copy()

    # Delivery duration in days
    merged['delivery_days'] = (merged['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days

    # Reviews aggregated per order (only those created up to seed_time)
    reviews_filtered = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time]
    review_agg = reviews_filtered.groupby('order_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        review_count=('review_score', 'count')
    ).reset_index()
    merged = merged.merge(review_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # Payments aggregated per order (only those with ts <= seed_time)
    payments_filtered = payments[payments['ts'] <= seed_time]
    payment_agg = payments_filtered.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean'),
        payment_installments_avg=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        payment_count=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
        credit_card_count=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').sum())
    ).reset_index()
    payment_agg['credit_card_rate'] = payment_agg['credit_card_count'] / payment_agg['payment_count'].replace(0, np.nan)
    payment_agg.drop(columns=['credit_card_count'], inplace=True)
    merged = merged.merge(payment_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # Time to seed for window aggregation
    merged['days_to_seed'] = (seed_time - merged['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days

    # Global aggregates for each product
    product_agg = merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_order_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_price=('price', 'sum'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
        min_freight=('freight_value', 'min'),
        max_freight=('freight_value', 'max'),
        unique_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        avg_review_score=('avg_review_score', 'mean'),
        review_count=('review_count', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_value=('avg_payment_value', 'mean'),
        total_payment_value=('total_payment_value', 'sum'),
        payment_installments_avg=('payment_installments_avg', 'mean'),
        credit_card_rate=('credit_card_rate', 'mean'),
        avg_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
        std_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'std'),
        min_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'min'),
        max_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'max')
    ).reset_index()

    # First and last purchase dates, recency and age
    date_agg = merged.groupby('product_id')['order_purchase_timestamp'].agg(
        first_purchase='min',
        last_purchase='max'
    ).reset_index()
    date_agg['age_days'] = (seed_time - date_agg['first_purchase']).dt.days
    date_agg['recency_days'] = (seed_time - date_agg['last_purchase']).dt.days
    product_agg = product_agg.merge(date_agg, on='product_id', how='left')

    # Order frequency = total_orders / age_days
    product_agg['order_frequency'] = product_agg['total_orders'] / product_agg['age_days'].replace(0, np.nan)

    # Window aggregates (30, 60, 90 days)
    for win in [30, 60, 90]:
        sub = merged[merged['days_to_seed'] <= win]
        agg_sub = sub.groupby('product_id').agg(
            **{f'order_items_{win}d': ('order_item_id', 'count')},
            **{f'unique_orders_{win}d': ('order_id', 'nunique')}
        ).reset_index()
        product_agg = product_agg.merge(agg_sub, on='product_id', how='left')

    # Set index, reindex to entity_ids, fill NaNs with 0
    product_agg = product_agg.set_index('product_id')
    product_agg = product_agg.reindex(entity_ids)
    product_agg = product_agg.fillna(0)

    return product_agg

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # ---- Общая база: items + orders (до seed_time) -------------------------
    base = items.merge(
        orders[
            [
                "order_id",
                "order_purchase_timestamp",
                "customer_id",
                "order_status",
                "order_delivered_customer_date",
                "order_estimated_delivery_date",
            ]
        ],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner",
    )
    base = base[base["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time]

    if base.empty:
        # Если нет продаж вообще, вернём DataFrame с нулями для всех entity_ids
        cols = [
            "order_count", "item_count", "total_price", "avg_price", "std_price",
            "sum_freight", "avg_freight", "unique_customers", "unique_sellers",
            "avg_delivery_time", "avg_delay", "count_orders_30d", "total_price_30d",
            "count_orders_60d", "total_price_60d", "count_orders_90d", "total_price_90d",
            "days_since_first", "days_since_last", "canceled_count",
            "review_count", "avg_score", "pos_ratio", "neg_ratio",
            "payment_txn_count", "sum_payment_value", "avg_payment_value",
            "avg_installments", "unique_payment_types",
        ]
        return pd.DataFrame(0, index=entity_ids, columns=cols)

    # Временные метрики
    base["days_to_seed"] = (seed_time - base["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    base["delivery_time"] = (base["order_delivered_customer_date"] - base["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    base["delay"] = (base["order_delivered_customer_date"] - base["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.days

    # ---- Агрегация продаж --------------------------------------------------
    agg_sales = base.groupby("product_id").agg(
        order_count=("order_id", "nunique"),
        item_count=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        std_price=("price", "std"),
        sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        first_purchase_ts=("order_purchase_timestamp", "min"),
        last_purchase_ts=("order_purchase_timestamp", "max"),
        avg_delivery_time=("delivery_time", "mean"),
        avg_delay=("delay", "mean"),
        canceled_count=("order_status", lambda x: (x == "canceled").sum()),
    )

    # Окна 30/60/90 дней
    for window in [30, 60, 90]:
        mask = base["days_to_seed"] <= window
        sub = base[mask]
        cnt = sub.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().rename(f"count_orders_{window}d")
        agg_sales = agg_sales.join(cnt, how="left")
        sum_price = sub.groupby("product_id")["price"].sum().rename(f"total_price_{window}d")
        agg_sales = agg_sales.join(sum_price, how="left")

    # Дни с первой/последней покупки
    agg_sales["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - agg_sales["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    agg_sales["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - agg_sales["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    agg_sales = agg_sales.drop(columns=["first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_ts"])

    # ---- Агрегация отзывов --------------------------------------------------
    reviews_filtered = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time]
    if not reviews_filtered.empty:
        items_prod = items[["order_id", "product_id"]]
        reviews_items = reviews_filtered.merge(items_prod, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if not reviews_items.empty:
            agg_reviews = reviews_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
                review_count=("review_id", "count"),
                avg_score=("review_score", "mean"),
                pos_ratio=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()),
                neg_ratio=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()),
            )
        else:
            agg_reviews = pd.DataFrame(
                columns=["review_count", "avg_score", "pos_ratio", "neg_ratio"]
            )
    else:
        agg_reviews = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["review_count", "avg_score", "pos_ratio", "neg_ratio"]
        )

    # ---- Агрегация платежей -------------------------------------------------
    payments_filtered = payments[payments["ts"] <= seed_time]
    if not payments_filtered.empty:
        items_prod = items[["order_id", "product_id"]]
        payments_items = payments_filtered.merge(items_prod, on="order_id", how="inner")
        if not payments_items.empty:
            agg_payments = payments_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
                payment_txn_count=("payment_sequential", "count"),
                sum_payment_value=("payment_value", "sum"),
                avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean"),
                avg_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
                unique_payment_types=("payment_type", "nunique"),
            )
        else:
            agg_payments = pd.DataFrame(
                columns=[
                    "payment_txn_count", "sum_payment_value", "avg_payment_value",
                    "avg_installments", "unique_payment_types"
                ]
            )
    else:
        agg_payments = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=[
                "payment_txn_count", "sum_payment_value", "avg_payment_value",
                "avg_installments", "unique_payment_types"
            ]
        )

    # ---- Объединение -------------------------------------------------------
    result = agg_sales.join(agg_reviews, how="left").join(agg_payments, how="left")
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)

    # Заполнение пропусков (нет истории / отдельные NaN)
    result = result.fillna(0)

    # Добавим общий доход (цена + доставка) как ещё один признак
    result["total_revenue"] = result["total_price"] + result["sum_freight"]

    return result

    features = features.fillna(0)

        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )

    items = items[items['order_purchase_timestamp'] <= seed_time]

    if items.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)

    ]

    feature_df.loc[avg_price.index, 'total_avg_price'] = avg_price
    std_price = grp['price'].std()

            merged2['avg_review_score'] = np.nan

        merged2['has_credit_card'] = 0
        merged2['avg_review_score'] = np.nan
        merged2['count_reviews'] = 0

    # Агрегируем по продукту

    avg_review_score = grp2['avg_review_score'].mean()
    feature_df.loc[avg_review_score.index, 'avg_review_score'] = avg_review_score
    count_reviews = grp2['count_reviews'].sum()

    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)

    result = result.fillna(0)

    if items.empty:

    features['avg_payment'] = grouped['total_payment'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    features['num_payments_total'] = grouped['num_payments'].sum().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # Отзывы
    features['avg_review_score'] = grouped['avg_review_score'].mean().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    features['num_reviews'] = grouped['num_reviews'].sum().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # Временные признаки
    features['days_since_last_purchase'] = grouped['days_since'].min().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)
    features['days_since_first_purchase'] = grouped['days_since'].max().reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # Количество заказов за последние окна
    for window in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        mask = item_agg['days_since'] <= window
        temp = item_agg[mask].groupby('product_id').size()
        features[f'orders_last_{window}d'] = temp.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

    # Заполняем возможные пропуски нулями (если какие-то товары отсутствовали)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    # Убеждаемся, что индекс точно соответствует entity_ids
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)

    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # extract dataframes
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # ensure entity_ids is list
    if not isinstance(entity_ids, (list, np.ndarray, pd.Series)):
        entity_ids = [entity_ids]
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    seed_time = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)
    
    # define feature names
    feature_cols = [
        'total_orders', 'total_items', 'unique_sellers',
        'price_mean', 'price_median', 'price_std', 'price_min', 'price_max',
        'freight_mean', 'freight_median', 'freight_std',
        'total_revenue',
        'orders_7d', 'orders_14d', 'orders_30d', 'orders_60d', 'orders_90d',
        'avg_review_score', 'review_count', 'negative_review_ratio',
        'payment_sum_mean', 'payment_count_mean', 'credit_card_share',
        'delivery_time_mean', 'delivered_ratio',
        'product_age_days'
    ]
    
    # initialize result DataFrame with zeros
    result = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=entity_ids, columns=feature_cols)
    
    # filter order_items for these products and before seed_time
    oi = order_items[order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)]
    if oi.empty:
        return result
    
    # merge with orders to get order info
    merged = oi.merge(orders, on='order_id', how='left')
    
    # unique (product_id, order_id) pairs for order-level features
    products_orders = merged.drop_duplicates(subset=['product_id', 'order_id']).copy()
    
    # --- Order-level counts ---
    po_group = products_orders.groupby('product_id')
    total_orders = po_group['order_id'].count()
    result.loc[total_orders.index, 'total_orders'] = total_orders
    
    # orders in last N days
    for N in [7,14,30,60,90]:
        mask = (products_orders['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=N))
        if mask.any():
            orders_N = products_orders.loc[mask].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            result.loc[orders_N.index, f'orders_{N}d'] = orders_N
    
    # --- Item-level features (all rows) ---
    product_groups = merged.groupby('product_id')
    total_items = product_groups.size()
    result.loc[total_items.index, 'total_items'] = total_items
    
    unique_sellers = merged.groupby('product_id')['seller_id'].nunique()
    result.loc[unique_sellers.index, 'unique_sellers'] = unique_sellers
    
    price_stats = merged.groupby('product_id')['price'].agg(['mean','median','std','min','max'])
    result.loc[price_stats.index, 'price_mean'] = price_stats['mean']
    result.loc[price_stats.index, 'price_median'] = price_stats['median']
    result.loc[price_stats.index, 'price_std'] = price_stats['std'].fillna(0)
    result.loc[price_stats.index, 'price_min'] = price_stats['min']
    result.loc[price_stats.index, 'price_max'] = price_stats['max']
    
    freight_stats = merged.groupby('product_id')['freight_value'].agg(['mean','median','std'])
    result.loc[freight_stats.index, 'freight_mean'] = freight_stats['mean']
    result.loc[freight_stats.index, 'freight_median'] = freight_stats['median']
    result.loc[freight_stats.index, 'freight_std'] = freight_stats['std'].fillna(0)
    
    total_revenue = merged.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum()
    result.loc[total_revenue.index, 'total_revenue'] = total_revenue
    
    # product age (days since first purchase)
    min_ts = merged.groupby('product_id')['ts'].min()
    product_age = (seed_time - min_ts).dt.days

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders']
    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # Фильтруем order_items по интересующим товарам и времени
    items_sel = items[items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids) & (items['ts'] <= seed_time)]
    
    # Создаём базовый DataFrame с индексом entity_ids
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))
    
    # ---- Признаки из order_items ----
    if len(items_sel) > 0:
        agg_items = items_sel.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_items=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            total_price=('price', 'sum'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            std_price=('price', 'std'),
            std_freight=('freight_value', 'std'),
            min_price=('price', 'min'),
            max_price=('price', 'max'),
            first_ts=('ts', 'min'),
            last_ts=('ts', 'max')
        )
        # Количество уникальных заказов
        total_orders = items_sel.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique().rename('total_orders')
        agg_items = agg_items.join(total_orders)
        agg_items['avg_items_per_order'] = agg_items['total_items'] / agg_items['total_orders']
        agg_items['recency_days'] = (seed_time - agg_items['last_ts']).dt.days
        agg_items['age_days'] = (seed_time - agg_items['first_ts']).dt.days
        agg_items['order_freq_monthly'] = agg_items['total_orders'] / (agg_items['age_days'].clip(lower=1) / 30.0)
        
        # Заказы за последние 30/60/90 дней
        for window in [30, 60, 90]:
            mask = items_sel['ts'] >= seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
            cnt = items_sel[mask].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique().rename(f'orders_last_{window}d')
            agg_items = agg_items.join(cnt, how='left').fillna(0)
        
        # Среднее отношение фрахт/цена
        items_sel_copy = items_sel.copy()
        items_sel_copy['freight_to_price'] = items_sel_copy['freight_value'] / items_sel_copy['price'].replace(0, np.nan)
        freight_ratio = items_sel_copy.groupby('product_id')['freight_to_price'].mean().rename('avg_freight_to_price')
        agg_items = agg_items.join(freight_ratio, how='left')
        
        features = features.join(agg_items, how='left')
    
    # ---- Признаки из orders (через уникальные пары product_id, order_id) ----
    pairs = items_sel[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
    if len(pairs) > 0:
        merged_orders = pairs.merge(orders, on='order_id', how='left')
        
        # Производные поля
        merged_orders['is_delivered'] = (merged_orders['order_status'] == 'delivered').astype(int)
        merged_orders['delivery_days'] = (merged_orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged_orders['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
        merged_orders['carrier_days'] = (merged_orders['order_delivered_carrier_date'] - merged_orders['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
        merged_orders['approval_days'] = (merged_orders['order_approved_at'] - merged_orders['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days
        merged_orders['delay_days'] = (merged_orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged_orders['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days
        merged_orders['early_delivery'] = (merged_orders['delay_days'] <= 0).astype(int)
        
        agg_orders = merged_orders.groupby('product_id').agg(
            num_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            num_unique_customers=('customer_id', 'nunique'),
            mean_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'mean'),
            std_delivery_days=('delivery_days', 'std'),
            mean_carrier_days=('carrier_days', 'mean'),
            mean_approval_days=('approval_days', 'mean'),
            mean_delay_days=('delay_days', 'mean'),
            pct_delivered=('is_delivered', 'mean'),
            pct_early_delivery=('early_delivery', 'mean')
        )
        features = features.join(agg_orders, how='left')
    
    # ---- Признаки из отзывов ----
    if len(pairs) > 0:
        rev_merged = reviews.merge(pairs[['order_id', 'product_id']], on='order_id')
        if len(rev_merged) > 0:
            rev_agg = rev_merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
                count_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
                mean_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                std_review_score=('review_score', 'std'),
                pct_high_review=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).mean())
            )
            features = features.join(rev_agg, how='left')
    
    # ---- Признаки из платежей ----
    if len(pairs) > 0:
        # Агрегируем платежи на уровне заказа
        pay_order = payments.groupby('order_id').agg(
            total_payment_order=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            n_payments_order=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
            max_installments_order=('payment_installments', 'max')
        )
        # Индикатор наличия оплаты кредитной картой
        cc_mask = payments['payment_type'] == 'credit_card'
        cc_order = payments[cc_mask].groupby('order_id')['payment_value'].sum().gt(0).astype(int).rename('has_cc')
        pay_order = pay_order.join(cc_order, how='left').fillna(0)
        
        pay_merged = pairs.merge(pay_order, on='order_id', how='left')
        agg_pay = pay_merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
            mean_total_payment=('total_payment_order', 'mean'),
            mean_n_payments=('n_payments_order', 'mean'),
            mean_max_installments=('max_installments_order', 'mean'),
            pct_credit_card=('has_cc', 'mean')
        )
        features = features.join(agg_pay, how='left')
    
    # ---- Общие признаки, одинаковые для всех (временные) ----
    features['seed_month'] = seed_time.month
    features['seed_dayofweek'] = seed_time.dayofweek
    features['seed_quarter'] = seed_time.quarter
    
    # Заполняем пропуски нулями (если товар не встречался ранее)
    features = features.fillna(0)
    
    # Явный признак "есть ли история заказов"
    if 'total_orders' in features.columns:
        features['has_orders'] = (features['total_orders'] > 0).astype(int)
    else:
        features['has_orders'] = 0
    
    # Добавляем признак: был ли товар заказан за последние 30 дней (может быть полезно)
    if 'orders_last_30d' in features.columns:
        features['ordered_recently'] = (features['orders_last_30d'] > 0).astype(int)
    else:
        features['ordered_recently'] = 0
    
    # Убеждаемся, что индекс строго соответствует entity_ids (порядок важен для реиндексации)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Возвращает матрицу признаков для каждого product_id на момент seed_time.
    Признаки строятся на основе исторических данных (до seed_time включительно).
    """
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db["orders"].copy()
    order_items = db["order_items"].copy()
    reviews = db["reviews"].copy()
    payments = db["payments"].copy()

    # Приводим типы дат
    orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(orders["order_purchase_timestamp"])
    reviews["review_creation_date"] = pd.to_datetime(reviews["review_creation_date"])
    payments["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(payments["ts"])
    order_items["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(order_items["ts"])

    # Фильтруем заказы, сделанные до seed_time
    mask_orders = orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time
    orders_pre = orders.loc[mask_orders, [
        "order_id", "order_status", "order_purchase_timestamp",
        "order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
        "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"
    ]].copy()

    # Фильтруем позиции по интересующим продуктам
    items_filtered = order_items[order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)].copy()

    # Присоединяем информацию о заказах (inner join, чтобы не было заказов после seed_time)
    merged = items_filtered.merge(orders_pre, on="order_id", how="inner")

    # Если нет никакой истории – возвращаем нулевые признаки для всех entity_ids
    if merged.empty:
        result = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
        result["has_history"] = 0
        result["total_orders"] = 0
        result["total_units"] = 0
        result["avg_price"] = 0.0
        result["median_price"] = 0.0
        result["sum_price"] = 0.0
        result["avg_freight"] = 0.0
        result["sum_freight"] = 0.0
        result["n_sellers"] = 0
        result["avg_review_score"] = 0.0
        result["n_reviews"] = 0
        result["avg_payment_value"] = 0.0
        result["sum_payment_value"] = 0.0
        result["payment_installments_avg"] = 0.0
        result["share_delivered"] = 0.0
        result["share_canceled"] = 0.0
        result["days_since_last_order"] = 9999.0
        for w in [30, 60, 90]:
            result[f"orders_{w}d"] = 0
            result[f"revenue_{w}d"] = 0.0
        return result

    # Агрегаты по заказам: платежи и отзывы
    payments_agg = payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
        payment_sum=("payment_value", "sum"),
        payment_mean=("payment_value", "mean"),
        installments_mean=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        n_payments=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    reviews_agg = reviews.groupby("order_id").agg(
        review_mean=("review_score", "mean"),
        review_count=("review_score", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    # Присоединяем агрегаты к merged
    merged = merged.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    merged = merged.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Заполняем NaN в агрегатах (если нет платежа или отзыва)
    merged["payment_sum"] = merged["payment_sum"].fillna(0)
    merged["payment_mean"] = merged["payment_mean"].fillna(0)
    merged["installments_mean"] = merged["installments_mean"].fillna(0)
    merged["n_payments"] = merged["n_payments"].fillna(0)
    merged["review_mean"] = merged["review_mean"].fillna(0)
    merged["review_count"] = merged["review_count"].fillna(0)

    # Добавляем временные признаки
    merged["days_ago"] = (seed_time - merged["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
    merged["days_to_delivery"] = (pd.to_datetime(merged["order_delivered_customer_date"]) - merged["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days

    # Группируем по product_id и вычисляем агрегаты
    group = merged.groupby("product_id")

    # Основные агрегаты
    feat = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    feat["has_history"] = 1
    feat["total_orders"] = group["order_id"].nunique()
    feat["total_units"] = group.size()
    feat["avg_price"] = group["price"].mean()
    feat["median_price"] = group["price"].median()
    feat["sum_price"] = group["price"].sum()
    feat["avg_freight"] = group["freight_value"].mean()
    feat["sum_freight"] = group["freight_value"].sum()
    feat["n_sellers"] = group["seller_id"].nunique()
    feat["avg_review_score"] = group["review_mean"].mean()
    feat["n_reviews"] = group["review_count"].sum()
    feat["avg_payment_value"] = group["payment_mean"].mean()
    feat["sum_payment_value"] = group["payment_sum"].sum()
    feat["payment_installments_avg"] = group["installments_mean"].mean()

    # Доли статусов
    status_counts = merged.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    for status in ["delivered", "canceled", "processing", "shipped"]:
        if status in status_counts.columns:
            feat[f"share_{status}"] = status_counts[status] / feat["total_orders"]
        else:
            feat[f"share_{status}"] = 0.0

    # Время с последнего заказа (в днях)
    last_purchase = group["order_purchase_timestamp"].max()
    feat["days_since_last_order"] = (seed_time - last_purchase).dt.days.fillna(9999)

    # Скользящие агрегаты за окна 30/60/90 дней
    for window in [30, 60, 90]:
        mask = merged["days_ago"] <= window
        df_window = merged[mask]
        if not df_window.empty:
            g = df_window.groupby("product_id")
            feat[f"orders_{window}d"] = g["order_id"].nunique()
            feat[f"revenue_{window}d"] = g["price"].sum()
        else:
            feat[f"orders_{window}d"] = 0
            feat[f"revenue_{window}d"] = 0.0

    # Заполняем возможные отсутствующие значения (например, если продукта нет в group)
    feat = feat.fillna({
        "total_orders": 0,
        "total_units": 0,
        "avg_price": 0.0,
        "median_price": 0.0,
        "sum_price": 0.0,
        "avg_freight": 0.0,
        "sum_freight": 0.0,
        "n_sellers": 0,
        "avg_review_score": 0.0,
        "n_reviews": 0,
        "avg_payment_value": 0.0,
        "sum_payment_value": 0.0,
        "payment_installments_avg": 0.0,
        "share_delivered": 0.0,
        "share_canceled": 0.0,
        "share_processing": 0.0,
        "share_shipped": 0.0,
        "days_since_last_order": 9999.0
    })

    # Приводим к float (некоторые могут быть int)
    for col in feat.columns:
        if col not in ["has_history", "n_sellers"]:
            feat[col] = feat[col].astype(float)

    # Убеждаемся, что все entity_ids присутствуют (даже без истории)
    feat = feat.reindex(entity_ids)
    # Если после reindex появились NaN (продукты без истории, но мы уже добавили has_history=1 только если были данные)
    # Поэтому для продуктов без данных они отсутствуют в feat, reindex создаст NaN
    # Заполняем:
    missing_mask = feat["has_history"].isna()
    if missing_mask.any():
        # Если нет истории, ставим has_history=0 и остальные нули
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "has_history"] = 0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "total_orders"] = 0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "total_units"] = 0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "avg_price"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "median_price"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "sum_price"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "avg_freight"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "sum_freight"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "n_sellers"] = 0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "avg_review_score"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "n_reviews"] = 0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "avg_payment_value"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "sum_payment_value"] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "payment_installments_avg"] = 0.0
        for col in ["share_delivered", "share_canceled", "share_processing", "share_shipped"]:
            feat.loc[missing_mask, col] = 0.0
        feat.loc[missing_mask, "days_since_last_order"] = 9999.0
        for w in [30, 60, 90]:
            feat.loc[missing_mask, f"orders_{w}d"] = 0
            feat.loc[missing_mask, f"revenue_{w}d"] = 0.0

    return feat

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Возвращает матрицу признаков для списка product_id на момент seed_time.
    Признаки строятся только на данных, известных до seed_time (ts < seed_time).
    """
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # Фильтруем order_items для наших товаров и до seed_time
    mask = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)) & (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)
    oi = order_items[mask].copy()

    # Список всех признаков
    feature_cols = [
        'count_30', 'count_60', 'count_90', 'count_180', 'count_365',
        'days_since_last',
        'price_mean', 'price_std', 'price_min', 'price_max', 'price_median',
        'freight_mean', 'freight_std',
        'total_revenue', 'count_orders', 'unique_sellers',
        'avg_review_score', 'num_reviews', 'high_review_ratio', 'review_coverage'
    ]

    # Пустой DataFrame с индексом entity_ids (для случая отсутствия истории)
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids, columns=feature_cols, dtype=float)

    if oi.empty:
        # Нет продаж — заполняем дни с последней продажи большим числом, остальное нулями
        features['days_since_last'] = 9999
        return features

    # Вычисляем вспомогательные столбцы
    oi['revenue'] = oi['price'] + oi['freight_value']
    oi['days_before'] = (seed_time - oi['ts']).dt.days

    # Базовые агрегаты по продукту
    grouped = oi.groupby('product_id')
    agg = pd.DataFrame(index=grouped.groups.keys())

    agg['count_items'] = grouped.size()
    agg['count_orders'] = grouped['order_id'].nunique()
    agg['unique_sellers'] = grouped['seller_id'].nunique()

    agg['price_mean'] = grouped['price'].mean()
    agg['price_std'] = grouped['price'].std().fillna(0)
    agg['price_min'] = grouped['price'].min()
    agg['price_max'] = grouped['price'].max()
    agg['price_median'] = grouped['price'].median()

    agg['freight_mean'] = grouped['freight_value'].mean()
    agg['freight_std'] = grouped['freight_value'].std().fillna(0)

    agg['total_revenue'] = grouped['revenue'].sum()
    agg['max_ts'] = grouped['ts'].max()

    # Количество продаж за последние N дней
    for days in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:
        mask_days = oi['days_before'] <= days
        counts = oi[mask_days].groupby('product_id').size()
        agg[f'count_{days}'] = counts.reindex(agg.index).fillna(0)

    # Дни с последней продажи (если нет продаж – заполняем 9999)
    days_since = (seed_time - agg['max_ts']).dt.days
    agg['days_since_last'] = days_since.fillna(9999)
    agg = agg.drop(columns=['max_ts'])

    # Признаки на основе отзывов
    order_ids_in_oi = oi['order_id'].unique()
    rev = reviews[reviews['order_id'].isin(order_ids_in_oi)][['order_id', 'review_score']]
    # На случай нескольких отзывов на заказ – берём среднее
    rev_agg = rev.groupby('order_id')['review_score'].mean().reset_index()
    oi_with_score = oi[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(rev_agg, on='order_id', how='left')

    # Средняя оценка и количество оценок
    score_group = oi_with_score.groupby('product_id')['review_score'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
    agg['avg_review_score'] = score_group['mean'].fillna(0)
    agg['num_reviews'] = score_group['count'].fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Доля заказов с высокой оценкой (>=4) среди всех заказов с товаром
    oi_with_score['high_score'] = ((oi_with_score['review_score'] >= 4) & 
                                   (oi_with_score['review_score'].notna())).astype(int)
    pairs = oi_with_score[['product_id', 'order_id', 'high_score']].drop_duplicates(['product_id', 'order_id'])
    high_sum = pairs.groupby('product_id')['high_score'].sum()
    agg['high_review_ratio'] = high_sum.reindex(agg.index).fillna(0) / agg['count_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)
    agg['high_review_ratio'] = agg['high_review_ratio'].fillna(0)

    # Доля заказов с отзывом
    agg['review_coverage'] = agg['num_reviews'] / agg['count_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)
    agg['review_coverage'] = agg['review_coverage'].fillna(0)

    # Реиндексация и заполнение пропусков
    features = agg[feature_cols].reindex(entity_ids)
    # Для товаров без истории days_since_last = 9999
    features['days_since_last'] = features['days_since_last'].fillna(9999)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # Переводим entity_ids в список (если ещё не)
    if not isinstance(entity_ids, list):
        entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    
    # 1. Отбираем заказы, сделанные до seed_time
    mask_orders = orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] <= seed_time
    orders_sel = orders.loc[mask_orders, ["order_id", "customer_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]]
    
    # 2. Присоединяем позиции товаров к выбранным заказам
    merged = items.merge(orders_sel, on="order_id", how="inner")
    # Оставляем только нужные товары
    merged = merged[merged["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)].copy()
    
    # Если нет данных по товарам, заполняем нулями
    if merged.empty:
        feat_df = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
        # зададим хотя бы один столбец, чтобы не пустой DataFrame
        feat_df["total_orders"] = 0
        return feat_df
    
    # 3. Базовые агрегаты по product_id
    base = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "size"),
        total_unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        sum_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),
        sum_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
        first_purchase_ts=("order_purchase_timestamp", "min"),
        last_purchase_ts=("order_purchase_timestamp", "max"),
        shipping_limit_min=("shipping_limit_date", "min"),
        shipping_limit_max=("shipping_limit_date", "max"),
        avg_shipping_delta=("shipping_limit_date", lambda x: (x - merged.loc[x.index, "order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days.mean()),
    )
    
    # Вычисляем производные временные признаки
    base["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - base["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    base["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - base["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    base["purchase_span_days"] = (base["last_purchase_ts"] - base["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    base["avg_interval_days"] = base.apply(
        lambda row: row["purchase_span_days"] / (row["total_orders"] - 1) if row["total_orders"] > 1 else np.nan, axis=1
    )
    
    # 4. Отзывы: присоединяем product_id к отзывам через заказы
    order_ids = merged["order_id"].unique()
    reviews_sel = reviews[(reviews["order_id"].isin(order_ids)) & (reviews["review_creation_date"] <= seed_time)]
    if not reviews_sel.empty:
        reviews_merged = reviews_sel.merge(
            merged[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="left"
        )
        # Убираем возможные NaN (если отзыв к заказу, которого нет в merged)
        reviews_merged = reviews_merged.dropna(subset=["product_id"])
        rev_agg = reviews_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            review_count=("review_score", "size"),
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            good_review_ratio=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()),
            bad_review_ratio=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()),
        )
    else:
        rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([], name="product_id"), columns=["review_count", "avg_review_score", "good_review_ratio", "bad_review_ratio"])
    
    # 5. Платежи: суммарный платёж на заказ, затем агрегация по product_id
    payments_sel = payments[payments["order_id"].isin(order_ids)]
    if not payments_sel.empty:
        # Суммарный платёж по заказу
        order_payment = payments_sel.groupby("order_id")["payment_value"].sum().rename("order_total_payment")
        # Среднее число платежей
        order_pay_count = payments_sel.groupby("order_id")["payment_sequential"].count().rename("order_pay_count")
        # Доля кредитных карт по заказу (по количеству платежей)
        order_cc = payments_sel.groupby("order_id")["payment_type"].apply(lambda x: (x == "credit_card").mean()).rename("order_cc_ratio")
        # Средний платеж по заказу (разделим сумму на число платежей)
        # Но лучше агрегировать по product_id через заказ
        pay_stats = pd.concat([order_payment, order_pay_count, order_cc], axis=1).reset_index()
        pay_merged = pay_stats.merge(
            merged[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="left"
        ).dropna(subset=["product_id"])
        
        pay_agg = pay_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_order_payment=("order_total_payment", "mean"),
            sum_order_payment=("order_total_payment", "sum"),
            avg_pay_count=("order_pay_count", "mean"),
            avg_cc_ratio=("order_cc_ratio", "mean"),
        )
    else:
        pay_agg = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([], name="product_id"), columns=["avg_order_payment", "sum_order_payment", "avg_pay_count", "avg_cc_ratio"])
    
    # 6. Дополнительные признаки: средний срок доставки? (shipping_limit_date - purchase_timestamp)

    # Также доля заказов, доставленных позже дедлайна? Это забегание в будущее, не надо.

    feat_df = feat_df.reindex(entity_ids)

    feat_df = feat_df.fillna(0)
    
    # Убираем столбцы с датами (они не являются числовыми, и после fillna стали нулями)

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db["orders"]
    items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    if not isinstance(entity_ids, list):
        entity_ids = list(entity_ids)

    orders_sel = orders.loc[mask_orders, ["order_id", "customer_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]]
    
    # 2. Присоединяем позиции товаров к выбранным заказам
    merged = items.merge(orders_sel, on="order_id", how="inner")
    # Оставляем только нужные товары
    merged = merged[merged["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)].copy()
    
    # Если нет данных по товарам, заполняем нулями
    if merged.empty:
        feat_df = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
        # зададим хотя бы один столбец, чтобы не пустой DataFrame
        feat_df["total_orders"] = 0
        return feat_df
    
    # 3. Базовые агрегаты по product_id
    base = merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
        total_items=("order_item_id", "size"),
        total_unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
        sum_price=("price", "sum"),
        avg_price=("price", "mean"),

        first_purchase_ts=("order_purchase_timestamp", "min"),
        last_purchase_ts=("order_purchase_timestamp", "max"),
        shipping_limit_min=("shipping_limit_date", "min"),
        shipping_limit_max=("shipping_limit_date", "max"),
        avg_shipping_delta=("shipping_limit_date", lambda x: (x - merged.loc[x.index, "order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days.mean()),
    )
    
    # Вычисляем производные временные признаки
    base["days_since_first"] = (seed_time - base["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    base["days_since_last"] = (seed_time - base["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    base["purchase_span_days"] = (base["last_purchase_ts"] - base["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    base["avg_interval_days"] = base.apply(
        lambda row: row["purchase_span_days"] / (row["total_orders"] - 1) if row["total_orders"] > 1 else np.nan, axis=1
    )
    
    # 4. Отзывы: присоединяем product_id к отзывам через заказы
    order_ids = merged["order_id"].unique()

    if not reviews_sel.empty:
        reviews_merged = reviews_sel.merge(
            merged[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="left"
        )
        # Убираем возможные NaN (если отзыв к заказу, которого нет в merged)
        reviews_merged = reviews_merged.dropna(subset=["product_id"])
        rev_agg = reviews_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            review_count=("review_score", "size"),
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            good_review_ratio=("review_score", lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()),
            bad_review_ratio=("review_score", lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()),
        )
    else:
        rev_agg = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index([], name="product_id"), columns=["review_count", "avg_review_score", "good_review_ratio", "bad_review_ratio"])

        # Средний платеж по заказу (разделим сумму на число платежей)
        # Но лучше агрегировать по product_id через заказ
        pay_stats = pd.concat([order_payment, order_pay_count, order_cc], axis=1).reset_index()
        pay_merged = pay_stats.merge(
            merged[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates(), on="order_id", how="left"
        ).dropna(subset=["product_id"])
        
        pay_agg = pay_merged.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_order_payment=("order_total_payment", "mean"),
            sum_order_payment=("order_total_payment", "sum"),
            avg_pay_count=("order_pay_count", "mean"),
            avg_cc_ratio=("order_cc_ratio", "mean"),

    if len(items) == 0:
        # Нет продаж до seed_time
        features = pd.DataFrame(0, index=entity_ids, columns=feature_cols)
        return features

        min_ts=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'min'),
        max_ts=('order_purchase_timestamp', 'max'),
        unique_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()

    # Возраст и давность последней покупки (в днях)
    agg['age_days'] = (seed_time - agg['min_ts']).dt.days
    agg['recency_days'] = (seed_time - agg['max_ts']).dt.days
    agg.drop(columns=['min_ts', 'max_ts'], inplace=True)

        agg = agg.merge(cnt, left_on='product_id', right_index=True, how='left')

        agg = agg.merge(rev_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    else:
        agg['avg_review_score'] = np.nan
        agg['review_count'] = 0

    # Средний интервал между заказами (в днях)
    def avg_interval_days(group):
        grp = group.sort_values()
        diff = grp.diff().dropna()
        if len(diff) > 0:
            return diff.mean().total_seconds() / 86400.0
        return np.nan

    intervals = items.groupby('product_id')['order_purchase_timestamp'].apply(avg_interval_days).rename('avg_interval_days')
    agg = agg.merge(intervals, left_on='product_id', right_index=True, how='left')

    # Устанавливаем индекс по product_id
    agg.set_index('product_id', inplace=True)

    # Переиндексируем по entity_ids, добавляя недостающие товары
    features = agg.reindex(entity_ids)

    # Заполняем пропуски нулями
    features = features.fillna(0)

    # Убедимся, что все признаки числовые
    features = features[feature_cols].astype(float)

    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    """
    Функция строит матрицу признаков для списка product_id на момент seed_time.
    Признаки рассчитываются только по данным, доступным до seed_time.
    """
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # Преобразуем entity_ids в набор для быстрого поиска
    product_set = set(entity_ids)
    
    # Фильтруем order_items: только нужные товары и ts <= seed_time
    items = order_items[
        order_items['product_id'].isin(product_set) &
        (order_items['ts'] <= seed_time)
    ].copy()
    
    # Если нет данных ни по одному товару, возвращаем DataFrame с нулями
    if items.empty:
        # Построим пустую матрицу с нужными колонками (определим вручную или через пустую обработку)
        # В этом случае используем минимальный набор признаков, чтобы обеспечить одинаковую структуру.
        # Проще определить все возможные признаки заранее и заполнить нулями.
        # Ниже мы перечислим все колонки, которые могут появиться.
        all_feats = [
            'num_positions', 'num_orders', 'unique_customers', 'age_days',
            'price_mean', 'price_median', 'price_sum', 'price_min', 'price_max',
            'freight_mean', 'freight_median', 'freight_sum', 'recency_days',
            'count_orders_last_7', 'count_orders_last_30', 'count_orders_last_90',
            'count_orders_last_180', 'count_orders_last_365',
            'review_score_mean', 'review_count',
            'total_payment_value', 'avg_payment_value',
            'avg_installments', 'unique_payment_types'
        ]
        # Создаем DataFrame с нулями и индексом entity_ids
        features = pd.DataFrame(0.0, index=entity_ids, columns=all_feats)
        return features
    
    # Присоединяем orders для получения customer_id и других данных
    items = items.merge(
        orders[[
            'order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
            'order_approved_at', 'order_delivered_carrier_date',
            'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date',
            'order_status'
        ]],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )
    
    # Агрегируем отзывы по order_id
    review_agg = reviews.groupby('order_id').agg(
        review_score_mean=('review_score', 'mean'),
        review_count=('review_id', 'count')
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Агрегируем платежи по order_id
    payment_agg = payments.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean'),
        avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
        unique_payment_types=('payment_type', 'nunique')
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Присоединяем агрегированные данные
    items = items.merge(review_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    items = items.merge(payment_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    
    # Функция для вычисления признаков для одного товара
    def compute_features(group):
        # group - DataFrame со всеми строками для одного product_id
        # Базовые признаки
        num_positions = len(group)
        num_orders = group['order_id'].nunique()
        unique_customers = group['customer_id'].nunique()
        first_purchase = group['ts'].min()
        age_days = (seed_time - first_purchase).days
        last_purchase = group['ts'].max()
        recency_days = (seed_time - last_purchase).days
        
        # Цены
        price_mean = group['price'].mean() if not group['price'].isna().all() else 0
        price_median = group['price'].median() if not group['price'].isna().all() else 0
        price_sum = group['price'].sum()
        price_min = group['price'].min() if not group['price'].isna().all() else 0
        price_max = group['price'].max() if not group['price'].isna().all() else 0
        
        # Фрахт
        freight_mean = group['freight_value'].mean() if not group['freight_value'].isna().all() else 0
        freight_median = group['freight_value'].median() if not group['freight_value'].isna().all() else 0
        freight_sum = group['freight_value'].sum()
        
        # Количество заказов за последние N дней
        windows = {}
        for days in [7, 30, 90, 180, 365]:
            threshold = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            count_orders = group[group['ts'] >= threshold]['order_id'].nunique()
            windows[f'count_orders_last_{days}'] = count_orders
        
        # Отзывы
        review_score_mean = group['review_score_mean'].mean() if not group['review_score_mean'].isna().all() else 0
        review_count = group['review_count'].sum() if not group['review_count'].isna().all() else 0
        
        # Платежи
        total_payment_value = group['total_payment_value'].sum() if not group['total_payment_value'].isna().all() else 0
        avg_payment_value = group['avg_payment_value'].mean() if not group['avg_payment_value'].isna().all() else 0
        avg_installments = group['avg_installments'].mean() if not group['avg_installments'].isna().all() else 0
        unique_payment_types = group['unique_payment_types'].max() if not group['unique_payment_types'].isna().all() else 0
        
        # Собираем все в Series
        feat = pd.Series({
            'num_positions': num_positions,
            'num_orders': num_orders,
            'unique_customers': unique_customers,
            'age_days': age_days,
            'price_mean': price_mean,
            'price_median': price_median,
            'price_sum': price_sum,
            'price_min': price_min,
            'price_max': price_max,
            'freight_mean': freight_mean,
            'freight_median': freight_median,
            'freight_sum': freight_sum,
            'recency_days': recency_days,
            **windows,  # count_orders_last_7, 30, 90, 180, 365
            'review_score_mean': review_score_mean,
            'review_count': review_count,
            'total_payment_value': total_payment_value,
            'avg_payment_value': avg_payment_value,
            'avg_installments': avg_installments,
            'unique_payment_types': unique_payment_types
        })
        return feat
    
    # Группируем и вычисляем признаки
    features = items.groupby('product_id').apply(compute_features)
    
    # Переиндексируем на entity_ids (порядок сохраняется)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    # Заполняем пропуски нулями (для товаров без продаж)
    features = features.fillna(0)
    
    # Приводим все к float
    features = features.astype(float)
    
    return features

    ).reset_index()
    
    # Средний интервал между покупками

    ).rename('avg_interval_days').reset_index()

    # Итоговый DataFrame для всех запрошенных товаров

    # Заполняем нулями товары без истории
    result = result.fillna(0)
    
    # Переиндексируем в соответствии с entity_ids
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    return result

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    """
    Функция строит признаки для каждого product_id на основе исторических данных
    до seed_time (не включая будущее).
    """
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    oi = db['order_items']
    
    # Фильтруем данные о покупках по времени и продуктам
    oi_seed = oi[(oi['ts'] < seed_time) & (oi['product_id'].isin(entity_ids))].copy()
    
    # Инициализируем DataFrame с нужным индексом
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))
    
    # ---------- Признаки из order_items ----------
    if not oi_seed.empty:
        grp = oi_seed.groupby('product_id')
        
        # Базовые агрегаты по продажам
        total_orders = grp['order_id'].nunique().rename('total_orders')
        total_quantity = grp.size().rename('total_quantity')
        total_revenue = grp['price'].sum().rename('total_revenue')
        avg_price = grp['price'].mean().rename('avg_price')
        std_price = grp['price'].std().rename('std_price')
        total_freight = grp['freight_value'].sum().rename('total_freight')
        avg_freight = grp['freight_value'].mean().rename('avg_freight')
        unique_sellers = grp['seller_id'].nunique().rename('unique_sellers')
        
        for s in [total_orders, total_quantity, total_revenue, avg_price, std_price,
                  total_freight, avg_freight, unique_sellers]:
            features = features.join(s)
        
        # Продажи за последние 30/60/90 дней
        for days in [30, 60, 90]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            mask = oi_seed['ts'] >= cutoff
            tmp = oi_seed[mask].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique().rename(f'sales_last_{days}')
            features = features.join(tmp)
        
        # Дней с последней покупки
        last_ts = grp['ts'].max().rename('last_purchase_ts')
        days_since = (seed_time - last_ts).dt.days.rename('days_since_last_purchase')
        features = features.join(days_since)
    
    # ---------- Признаки из reviews ----------
    # Получаем уникальные пары заказ-товар для наших продуктов
    if not oi_seed.empty:
        order_prod = oi_seed[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
        orders_list = order_prod['order_id'].unique()
        
        rev = db['reviews']
        reviews_seed = rev[(rev['order_id'].isin(orders_list)) & (rev['review_creation_date'] < seed_time)]
        if not reviews_seed.empty:
            reviews_joined = reviews_seed.merge(order_prod, on='order_id', how='left')
            rgrp = reviews_joined.groupby('product_id')
            
            review_count = rgrp.size().rename('review_count')
            avg_review_score = rgrp['review_score'].mean().rename('avg_review_score')
            std_review_score = rgrp['review_score'].std().rename('std_review_score')
            high_score_ratio = rgrp['review_score'].apply(lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()).rename('high_score_ratio')
            low_score_ratio = rgrp['review_score'].apply(lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()).rename('low_score_ratio')
            
            for s in [review_count, avg_review_score, std_review_score, high_score_ratio, low_score_ratio]:
                features = features.join(s)
    
    # ---------- Признаки из payments ----------
    if not oi_seed.empty:
        order_prod = oi_seed[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
        orders_list = order_prod['order_id'].unique()
        
        pay = db['payments']
        payments_seed = pay[(pay['order_id'].isin(orders_list)) & (pay['ts'] < seed_time)]
        if not payments_seed.empty:
            pay_joined = payments_seed.merge(order_prod, on='order_id', how='left')
            pgrp = pay_joined.groupby('product_id')
            
            avg_payment_value = pgrp['payment_value'].mean().rename('avg_payment_value')
            avg_installments = pgrp['payment_installments'].mean().rename('avg_installments')
            payment_count = pgrp.size().rename('payment_count')
            unique_payment_types = pgrp['payment_type'].nunique().rename('unique_payment_types')
            
            for s in [avg_payment_value, avg_installments, payment_count, unique_payment_types]:
                features = features.join(s)
    
    # ---------- Гарантируем наличие всех признаков ----------
    expected_cols = [
        'total_orders', 'total_quantity', 'total_revenue', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'total_freight', 'avg_freight', 'unique_sellers',
        'sales_last_30', 'sales_last_60', 'sales_last_90',
        'days_since_last_purchase',
        'review_count', 'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'high_score_ratio', 'low_score_ratio',
        'avg_payment_value', 'avg_installments', 'payment_count', 'unique_payment_types'
    ]
    for col in expected_cols:
        if col not in features.columns:
            features[col] = np.nan
    
    # Заполняем счётчики нулями (если нет данных)
    zero_fill_cols = [
        'total_orders', 'total_quantity', 'total_revenue', 'total_freight', 'unique_sellers',
        'sales_last_30', 'sales_last_60', 'sales_last_90',
        'review_count', 'payment_count'
    ]
    for col in zero_fill_cols:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(0)
    
    # Дней с последней покупки: большое значение если продаж не было
    features['days_since_last_purchase'] = features['days_since_last_purchase'].fillna(10000)
    
    # Реиндексация для гарантии порядка
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features

import numpy as np

def get_features(db, entity_ids, seed_time):
    """
    Функция строит признаки для каждого product_id на основе исторических данных
    до seed_time (не включая будущее).
    """
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    oi = db['order_items']
    
    # Фильтруем данные о покупках по времени и продуктам
    oi_seed = oi[(oi['ts'] < seed_time) & (oi['product_id'].isin(entity_ids))].copy()
    
    # Инициализируем DataFrame с нужным индексом
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name='product_id'))
    
    # ---------- Признаки из order_items ----------
    if not oi_seed.empty:
        grp = oi_seed.groupby('product_id')
        
        # Базовые агрегаты по продажам
        total_orders = grp['order_id'].nunique().rename('total_orders')
        total_quantity = grp.size().rename('total_quantity')
        total_revenue = grp['price'].sum().rename('total_revenue')
        avg_price = grp['price'].mean().rename('avg_price')
        std_price = grp['price'].std().rename('std_price')
        total_freight = grp['freight_value'].sum().rename('total_freight')
        avg_freight = grp['freight_value'].mean().rename('avg_freight')
        unique_sellers = grp['seller_id'].nunique().rename('unique_sellers')
        
        for s in [total_orders, total_quantity, total_revenue, avg_price, std_price,
                  total_freight, avg_freight, unique_sellers]:
            features = features.join(s)
        
        # Продажи за последние 30/60/90 дней
        for days in [30, 60, 90]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            mask = oi_seed['ts'] >= cutoff
            tmp = oi_seed[mask].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique().rename(f'sales_last_{days}')
            features = features.join(tmp)
        
        # Дней с последней покупки
        last_ts = grp['ts'].max().rename('last_purchase_ts')
        days_since = (seed_time - last_ts).dt.days.rename('days_since_last_purchase')
        features = features.join(days_since)
    
    # ---------- Признаки из reviews ----------
    # Получаем уникальные пары заказ-товар для наших продуктов
    if not oi_seed.empty:
        order_prod = oi_seed[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
        orders_list = order_prod['order_id'].unique()
        
        rev = db['reviews']
        reviews_seed = rev[(rev['order_id'].isin(orders_list)) & (rev['review_creation_date'] < seed_time)]
        if not reviews_seed.empty:
            reviews_joined = reviews_seed.merge(order_prod, on='order_id', how='left')
            rgrp = reviews_joined.groupby('product_id')
            
            review_count = rgrp.size().rename('review_count')
            avg_review_score = rgrp['review_score'].mean().rename('avg_review_score')
            std_review_score = rgrp['review_score'].std().rename('std_review_score')
            high_score_ratio = rgrp['review_score'].apply(lambda x: (x >= 4).mean()).rename('high_score_ratio')
            low_score_ratio = rgrp['review_score'].apply(lambda x: (x <= 2).mean()).rename('low_score_ratio')
            
            for s in [review_count, avg_review_score, std_review_score, high_score_ratio, low_score_ratio]:
                features = features.join(s)
    
    # ---------- Признаки из payments ----------
    if not oi_seed.empty:
        order_prod = oi_seed[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
        orders_list = order_prod['order_id'].unique()
        
        pay = db['payments']
        payments_seed = pay[(pay['order_id'].isin(orders_list)) & (pay['ts'] < seed_time)]
        if not payments_seed.empty:
            pay_joined = payments_seed.merge(order_prod, on='order_id', how='left')
            pgrp = pay_joined.groupby('product_id')
            
            avg_payment_value = pgrp['payment_value'].mean().rename('avg_payment_value')
            avg_installments = pgrp['payment_installments'].mean().rename('avg_installments')
            payment_count = pgrp.size().rename('payment_count')
            unique_payment_types = pgrp['payment_type'].nunique().rename('unique_payment_types')
            
            for s in [avg_payment_value, avg_installments, payment_count, unique_payment_types]:
                features = features.join(s)
    
    # ---------- Гарантируем наличие всех признаков ----------
    expected_cols = [
        'total_orders', 'total_quantity', 'total_revenue', 'avg_price', 'std_price',
        'total_freight', 'avg_freight', 'unique_sellers',
        'sales_last_30', 'sales_last_60', 'sales_last_90',
        'days_since_last_purchase',
        'review_count', 'avg_review_score', 'std_review_score', 'high_score_ratio', 'low_score_ratio',
        'avg_payment_value', 'avg_installments', 'payment_count', 'unique_payment_types'
    ]
    for col in expected_cols:
        if col not in features.columns:
            features[col] = np.nan
    
    # Заполняем счётчики нулями (если нет данных)
    zero_fill_cols = [
        'total_orders', 'total_quantity', 'total_revenue', 'total_freight', 'unique_sellers',
        'sales_last_30', 'sales_last_60', 'sales_last_90',
        'review_count', 'payment_count'
    ]
    for col in zero_fill_cols:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(0)
    
    # Дней с последней покупки: большое значение если продаж не было
    features['days_since_last_purchase'] = features['days_since_last_purchase'].fillna(10000)
    
    # Реиндексация для гарантии порядка
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features

    import numpy as np

    # Convert entity_ids to list
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    
    # Extract tables

    items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # Prepare items: filter by ts <= seed_time
    items = items[items['ts'] <= seed_time].copy()
    
    # Base feature frame
    feats = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    
    # Helper to apply grouped aggregations to feats
    def add_agg(df, group_col, agg_spec, prefix):
        if len(df) == 0:
            # add empty columns with NaNs
            for col_name in agg_spec.keys():
                col = prefix + '_' + col_name
                feats[col] = pd.Series(index=feats.index, dtype='float64')
            return
        grouped = df.groupby(group_col).agg(agg_spec).reset_index()
        for orig_col, new_col in zip(agg_spec.keys(), [prefix + '_' + k for k in agg_spec.keys()]):
            if orig_col in grouped.columns:
                feats[new_col] = feats.index.map(
                    dict(zip(grouped[group_col], grouped[orig_col]))
                )
    
    # --- All-time aggregates (until seed_time) ---
    if len(items) > 0:
        all_agg = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_orders_all=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            total_qty_all=('order_id', 'size'),
            total_price_all=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price_all=('price', 'mean'),
            avg_freight_all=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            num_sellers_all=('seller_id', 'nunique')
        ).reset_index()
        for col in all_agg.columns[1:]:
            feats[col] = feats.index.map(dict(zip(all_agg['product_id'], all_agg[col])))
        
        # Days since first/last purchase
        first_last = items.groupby('product_id')['ts'].agg(['min', 'max']).reset_index()
        first_last.columns = ['product_id', 'first_ts', 'last_ts']
        first_last['days_since_first'] = (seed_time - first_last['first_ts']).dt.days
        first_last['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - first_last['last_ts']).dt.days
        for col in ['days_since_first', 'days_since_last']:
            feats[col] = feats.index.map(dict(zip(first_last['product_id'], first_last[col])))
    else:
        # Fill empty all-time features with NaN (will be handled later)
        pass
    
    # --- Window aggregates (30, 60, 90, 180, 365) ---
    windows = [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]

        start = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w)
        items_win = items[items['ts'] >= start]

                **{f'total_orders_w{w}': ('order_id', 'nunique'),

                   f'avg_price_w{w}': ('price', 'mean'),
                   f'avg_freight_w{w}': ('freight_value', 'mean'),
                   f'total_revenue_w{w}': ('price', 'sum')}
            ).reset_index()
            for col in win_agg.columns[1:]:
                feats[col] = feats.index.map(dict(zip(win_agg['product_id'], win_agg[col])))
    
    # --- Review features (all time and windows) ---

    reviews_sub = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] <= seed_time][['order_id', 'review_score']]

        merged = items.merge(reviews_sub, on='order_id', how='inner')
        if len(merged) > 0:
