    merged = items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'customer_id', 'order_status', 
                'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_delivered_customer_date']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )

    # Базовые агрегаты по товарам
    agg_base = merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_items=('order_id', 'count'),
        total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),

    if not agg_base.empty:
        # Дней с последней покупки

        # Дней с первой покупки
        agg_base['first_order_days'] = (seed_time - agg_base['first_ts']).dt.days
        # Частота заказов (кол-во в месяц)
        span_days = (agg_base['last_ts'] - agg_base['first_ts']).dt.days
        span_months = (span_days / 30).clip(lower=0.1)  # минимум 0.1 месяца

        ).reset_index()
        agg_base = agg_base.merge(agg_reviews, on='product_id', how='left')
    else:
        agg_base['review_count'] = np.nan

    # Агрегация платежей
    pay_merged = merged[['product_id', 'order_id']].merge(

    # Фильтруем по времени платежа < seed_time
    pay_merged = pay_merged[pay_merged['ts'] < seed_time]
    if not pay_merged.empty:
        agg_payments = pay_merged.groupby('product_id').agg(
            avg_payment_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            payment_count=('payment_sequential', 'count')
        ).reset_index()
        agg_base = agg_base.merge(agg_payments, on='product_id', how='left')
    else:
        agg_base['avg_payment_installments'] = np.nan
        agg_base['total_payment_value'] = np.nan
        agg_base['payment_count'] = np.nan

    # Устанавливаем index = product_id
    agg_base = agg_base.set_index('product_id')

    # Реиндексация по всем entity_ids
    result = agg_base.reindex(entity_ids)

    for col in count_cols:

    mean_cols = ['avg_price', 'std_price', 'avg_freight', 'avg_review_score', 'avg_payment_installments']
    for col in mean_cols:

    # Специальные значения для времён

    # Удаляем вспомогательные колонки с датами (если остались), но их нет

    result = result.astype(float)

            'days_since_last_purchase': 'float64', 'days_since_first_purchase': 'float64'
        })

    # Временные интервалы между покупками
    if not items.empty:
        items_sorted = items[['product_id', 'ts']].sort_values(['product_id', 'ts'])

        gaps = items_sorted.dropna(subset=['gap_days'])

                min_gap_days='min',
                max_gap_days='max'
            ).reset_index()
        else:

    else:

        cust_agg = unique_orders_cust.groupby('product_id').agg(

        ).reset_index()
    else:

    if not items.empty:
        unique_orders_for_rev = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
        reviews = db['reviews']
        reviews = reviews[reviews['order_id'].isin(unique_orders_for_rev['order_id']) & (reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time)]
        if not reviews.empty:
            rel_reviews = unique_orders_for_rev.merge(reviews[['order_id', 'review_score']], on='order_id', how='left')
            review_agg = rel_reviews.groupby('product_id').agg(
                review_count=('review_score', 'count'),
                review_mean=('review_score', 'mean'),
                review_std=('review_score', 'std'),
                review_positive_count=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).sum()),
                review_negative_count=('review_score', lambda x: (x <= 2).sum()),
                review_positive_ratio=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).mean() if len(x) > 0 else 0)
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            review_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'review_count', 'review_mean', 'review_std', 'review_positive_count', 'review_negative_count', 'review_positive_ratio'])
    else:
        review_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'review_count', 'review_mean', 'review_std', 'review_positive_count', 'review_negative_count', 'review_positive_ratio'])

    # Платёжные характеристики заказов с товаром
    if not items.empty:
        unique_orders_for_pay = items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()
        payments = db['payments']
        payments = payments[payments['order_id'].isin(unique_orders_for_pay['order_id']) & (payments['ts'] < seed_time)]
        if not payments.empty:
            pay_order = payments.groupby('order_id').agg(
                sum_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
                count_payments=('payment_value', 'count'),
                mean_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean')
            ).reset_index()
            rel_pay = unique_orders_for_pay.merge(pay_order, on='order_id', how='left')
            pay_agg = rel_pay.groupby('product_id').agg(
                pay_sum_mean=('sum_payment', 'mean'),
                pay_sum_median=('sum_payment', 'median'),
                pay_sum_std=('sum_payment', 'std'),
                pay_count_mean=('count_payments', 'mean'),
                pay_installments_mean=('mean_installments', 'mean')
            ).reset_index()
        else:
            pay_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'pay_sum_mean', 'pay_sum_median', 'pay_sum_std', 'pay_count_mean', 'pay_installments_mean'])
    else:
        pay_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=['product_id', 'pay_sum_mean', 'pay_sum_median', 'pay_sum_std', 'pay_count_mean', 'pay_installments_mean'])

    # Собираем все признаки
    features = agg_items.merge(gap_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    features = features.merge(cust_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    features = features.merge(review_agg, on='product_id', how='left')
    features = features.merge(pay_agg, on='product_id', how='left')

    # Индикатор наличия истории
    features['has_history'] = (features['count_orders_items'] > 0).astype(int)

    # Сезонные признаки (константные для данного seed_time)
    features['seed_time_month'] = seed_time.month
    features['seed_time_dayofweek'] = seed_time.dayofweek
    features['seed_time_quarter'] = seed_time.quarter

    # Устанавливаем индекс product_id и реиндексируем под все запрошенные entity_ids
    features.set_index('product_id', inplace=True)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    features = features.fillna(0)

    return features

    for days in [30, 60, 90, 180, 365]:

    # Замена всех оставшихся NaN и бесконечностей нулями
    res = res.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], 0).fillna(0)

    return res

    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']

    # Фильтруем по времени (события строго до seed_time)
    orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]
    order_items = order_items[order_items['ts'] < seed_time]
    reviews = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    payments = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]

    # Инициализируем результирующий DataFrame
    result = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)

    # ----- Признаки из order_items (позиции товара) -----
    # Количество позиций (продаж единиц)
    sales_count = order_items.groupby('product_id').size().rename('sales_count')
    result = result.join(sales_count, how='left')

    # Суммарная выручка (price)
    total_revenue = order_items.groupby('product_id')['price'].sum().rename('total_revenue')
    result = result.join(total_revenue, how='left')

    # Средняя цена
    avg_price = order_items.groupby('product_id')['price'].mean().rename('avg_price')
    result = result.join(avg_price, how='left')

    # Средний фрахт
    avg_freight = order_items.groupby('product_id')['freight_value'].mean().rename('avg_freight')
    result = result.join(avg_freight, how='left')

    # Количество уникальных продавцов
    unique_sellers = order_items.groupby('product_id')['seller_id'].nunique().rename('unique_sellers')
    result = result.join(unique_sellers, how='left')

    # ----- Признаки на уровне заказов -----
    # Уникальные пары товар-заказ
    uniq_pairs = order_items[['product_id', 'order_id']].drop_duplicates()

    # Количество уникальных заказов (заказов, где есть товар)
    unique_orders = uniq_pairs.groupby('product_id').size().rename('unique_orders')
    result = result.join(unique_orders, how='left')

    # Соединяем с orders (inner join, т.к. заказ должен существовать и соответствовать фильтру)
    merged_orders = uniq_pairs.merge(orders, on='order_id', how='inner')

    # Уникальные покупатели
    unique_customers = merged_orders.groupby('product_id')['customer_id'].nunique().rename('unique_customers')
    result = result.join(unique_customers, how='left')

    # Временные признаки относительно seed_time
    merged_orders['days_since_purchase'] = (seed_time - merged_orders['order_purchase_timestamp']).dt.days

    # Дни с последней покупки (минимум)
    days_since_last_purchase = merged_orders.groupby('product_id')['days_since_purchase'].min().rename('days_since_last_purchase')
    result = result.join(days_since_last_purchase, how='left')

    # Дни с первой покупки (максимум)
    days_since_first_purchase = merged_orders.groupby('product_id')['days_since_purchase'].max().rename('days_since_first_purchase')
    result = result.join(days_since_first_purchase, how='left')

    # Среднее количество дней с покупки
    avg_days_since_purchase = merged_orders.groupby('product_id')['days_since_purchase'].mean().rename('avg_days_since_purchase')
    result = result.join(avg_days_since_purchase, how='left')

    # Количество заказов за последние 30, 60, 90 дней
    for window in [30, 60, 90]:
        mask = merged_orders['days_since_purchase'] <= window

    # Признаки доставки (если доставлено)

    merged_orders['delivery_diff'] = (merged_orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] - merged_orders['order_estimated_delivery_date']).dt.days

    avg_delivery_days = merged_orders.groupby('product_id')['delivery_days'].mean().rename('avg_delivery_days')

    avg_delivery_diff = merged_orders.groupby('product_id')['delivery_diff'].mean().rename('avg_delivery_diff')
    result = result.join(avg_delivery_diff, how='left')

    # Доля заказов с задержкой доставки
    merged_orders['is_delayed'] = (merged_orders['delivery_diff'] > 0).astype(int)

        base['avg_freight'] = np.nan
        base['unique_sale_days'] = 0
        base['first_order_date'] = pd.NaT
        base['last_order_date'] = pd.NaT
        base['days_since_first_order'] = np.nan
        base['days_since_last_order'] = np.nan
        base['avg_interval_days'] = np.nan
    else:
        # Основные агрегаты по всем продажам
        base = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            total_items=('order_id', 'count'),
            total_revenue=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            unique_sale_days=('ts', 'nunique'),

        ).reset_index()
        
        # Интервал между заказами (среднее) при наличии >1 заказа
        base['avg_interval_days'] = np.where(

            np.nan
        )
        
        # Дни с первого / последнего заказа
        base['days_since_first_order'] = (seed_time - base['first_ts']).dt.days
        base['days_since_last_order'] = (seed_time - base['last_ts']).dt.days
        base = base.drop(columns=['first_ts', 'last_ts'])
        
        # ---------- Агрегации за последние N дней ----------
        for w in [7, 30, 60, 90]:
            items_w = items[items['ts'] >= (seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=w))]
            if not items_w.empty:
                temp = items_w.groupby('product_id').agg(
                    **{f'orders_last_{w}d': ('order_id', 'nunique')},
                    **{f'items_last_{w}d': ('order_id', 'count')},
                    **{f'revenue_last_{w}d': ('price', 'sum')}
                ).reset_index()

            # Присоединяем отзывы к позициям товаров
            items_rev = items[['order_id', 'product_id']].merge(reviews_f[['order_id', 'review_score']], on='order_id', how='left')

            base['pos_review_ratio'] = 0.0

    else:

        base['avg_review_score'] = np.nan
        base['std_review_score'] = np.nan
        base['pos_review_ratio'] = 0.0
        base['neg_review_ratio'] = 0.0
    
    # ---------- Платежи ----------

            pay_agg = items_pay.groupby('product_id').agg(

                avg_payment_value=('payment_value', 'mean'),
                credit_card_ratio=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').mean())
            ).reset_index()
            base = base.join(pay_agg.set_index('product_id'), how='left')
        else:
            base['avg_installments'] = np.nan
            base['avg_payment_value'] = np.nan
            base['credit_card_ratio'] = 0.0
    else:

        base['avg_payment_value'] = np.nan
        base['credit_card_ratio'] = 0.0
    
    # ---------- Временные признаки seed_time ----------

    base['day_of_week'] = seed_time.dayofweek
    base['day_of_year'] = seed_time.dayofyear
    
    # ---------- Реиндексация по всем product_ids ----------
    base = base.reindex(product_ids)
    
    # Заполняем нулями счётчики и суммы, где это уместно
    for col in base.columns:
        if 'last_' in col and 'revenue_last_' in col:
            base[col] = base[col].fillna(0.0)
        elif 'last_' in col and ('orders_last_' in col or 'items_last_' in col):
            base[col] = base[col].fillna(0)
    base['total_orders'] = base['total_orders'].fillna(0).astype(int)
    base['total_items'] = base['total_items'].fillna(0).astype(int)
    base['total_revenue'] = base['total_revenue'].fillna(0.0)

    base['pos_review_ratio'] = base['pos_review_ratio'].fillna(0.0)
    base['neg_review_ratio'] = base['neg_review_ratio'].fillna(0.0)
    
    # Для средних и дней оставляем NaN (если нет продаж)
    return base

    items = db['order_items'].copy()

    orders = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time]

    df = items.merge(
        orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp',
                'order_delivered_customer_date', 'order_estimated_delivery_date']],
        on='order_id', how='left'
    )

    # Отзывы (только до seed_time)
    reviews = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    if len(reviews) > 0:
        reviews_agg = reviews.groupby('order_id').agg(
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            review_count=('review_score', 'size'),
            positive_review_count=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).sum())
        ).reset_index()
        df = df.merge(reviews_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    else:
        df['avg_review_score'] = np.nan
        df['review_count'] = 0
        df['positive_review_count'] = 0

    # Платежи (только до seed_time)
    payments = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    if len(payments) > 0:
        payments_agg = payments.groupby('order_id').agg(
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            total_payment_value=('payment_value', 'sum')
        ).reset_index()
        df = df.merge(payments_agg, on='order_id', how='left')
    else:
        df['avg_installments'] = np.nan
        df['total_payment_value'] = np.nan

    # Задержка доставки (если обе даты присутствуют)
    delivered = df['order_delivered_customer_date'].notna() & df['order_estimated_delivery_date'].notna()
    df['delivery_delay'] = np.nan
    df.loc[delivered, 'delivery_delay'] = (
        df.loc[delivered, 'order_delivered_customer_date'] - df.loc[delivered, 'order_estimated_delivery_date']
    ).dt.days

    # Агрегация по продуктам
    grouped = df.groupby('product_id').agg(
        sales_count=('order_item_id', 'size'),

        sum_price=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),

        avg_installments=('avg_installments', 'mean'),
        total_payment_value=('total_payment_value', 'sum'),
        avg_delivery_delay=('delivery_delay', 'mean')
    ).reset_index()

    # Производные признаки
    grouped['days_since_last_purchase'] = (seed_time - grouped['max_ts']).dt.days
    grouped['days_since_first_purchase'] = (seed_time - grouped['min_ts']).dt.days
    grouped['avg_days_between_purchases'] = np.where(
        grouped['sales_count'] > 1,
        (grouped['max_ts'] - grouped['min_ts']).dt.days / (grouped['sales_count'] - 1),
        np.nan
    )
    grouped['positive_review_ratio'] = np.where(
        grouped['review_count'] > 0,
        grouped['positive_review_count'] / grouped['review_count'],
        0
    )

    base_ts = items['ts']
    for days, prefix in [(7, '7d'), (30, '30d'), (90, '90d')]:
        mask = base_ts >= (seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days))
        sub = items[mask]
        if len(sub) > 0:
            sales = sub.groupby('product_id').size().rename(f'sales_{prefix}')
        else:
            sales = pd.Series(dtype=int)
        grouped = grouped.merge(sales, left_on='product_id', right_index=True, how='left')

    # Заполняем отсутствующие продажи нулями
    for prefix in ['7d', '30d', '90d']:
        col = f'sales_{prefix}'
        if col in grouped.columns:
            grouped[col] = grouped[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

    # Итоговый DataFrame с индексом entity_ids
    result = grouped.set_index('product_id')
    result = result.reindex(entity_ids)
    # Заполняем NaN нулями (кроме, возможно, avg_review_score, но для простоты)
    result = result.fillna(0)

    # Убираем лишние колонки (product_id уже в индексе)
    if 'product_id' in result.columns:
        result = result.drop(columns=['product_id'])

    return result.loc[entity_ids]

        total_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum"),

        max_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="max"),
        avg_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        days_since_last_sale=pd.NamedAgg(
            column="ts",
            aggfunc=lambda x: (seed_time - x.max()).days if len(x) > 0 else np.inf
        )
    )
    
    # Windowed aggregates (30, 90, 180 days)
    window_params = [
        (30, "30d"),
        (90, "90d"),
        (180, "180d")
    ]
    
    for window_days, suffix in window_params:
        cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window_days)

                f"freight_value_{suffix}": pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum")
            }
        )
        prod_agg = prod_agg.join(win_agg, how="left")

        for col in [f"units_sold_{suffix}", f"orders_count_{suffix}", f"sales_value_{suffix}", f"freight_value_{suffix}"]:
            prod_agg[col] = prod_agg[col].fillna(0)

    )

    )
    prod_agg = prod_agg.join(review_agg, how="left")
    # Fill review aggregates: 0 for counts, 0 for scores (or neutral 3, use 0 for simplicity)
    for col in review_agg.columns:
        prod_agg[col] = prod_agg[col].fillna(0)
    
    # Payment aggregates: link payments to products via order_items
    order_product_payments = order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(
        payments, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    payment_agg = order_product_payments.groupby("product_id", observed=True).agg(
        total_payments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_sequential", aggfunc="count"),
        avg_payment_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        total_payment_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="sum"),
        avg_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="mean")
    )

    # Fill payment aggregates: 0 for counts, 0 for averages

    # Replace inf (never sold) with 2 years (730 days)
    prod_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = prod_agg["days_since_last_sale"].replace(np.inf, 730)
    
    # Reindex to requested entity IDs, fill remaining NaNs with 0
    final_features = prod_agg.reindex(entity_ids).fillna(0)

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    index = pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id")
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=index)
    def join_feature(series):
        nonlocal features
        features = features.join(series, how="left")
        features[series.name] = features[series.name].fillna(0)
    # Process order_items historical data
    oi = db["order_items"]
    oi_hist = oi[oi["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    oi_grp = oi_hist.groupby("product_id")
    # Core order item features
    total_units = oi_grp.size().rename("total_units")
    join_feature(total_units)
    total_orders = oi_grp["order_id"].nunique().rename("total_orders")
    join_feature(total_orders)
    total_revenue = oi_grp["price"].sum().rename("total_revenue")
    join_feature(total_revenue)
    avg_price = oi_grp["price"].mean().rename("avg_price")
    join_feature(avg_price)
    total_freight = oi_grp["freight_value"].sum().rename("total_freight")
    join_feature(total_freight)
    avg_freight = oi_grp["freight_value"].mean().rename("avg_freight")
    join_feature(avg_freight)
    unique_sellers = oi_grp["seller_id"].nunique().rename("unique_sellers")
    join_feature(unique_sellers)
    # Time-based order features
    if not oi_hist.empty:
        last_order_ts = oi_grp["ts"].max()
        days_since_last = (seed_time - last_order_ts).dt.days.rename("days_since_last_order")
        join_feature(days_since_last)
        first_order_ts = oi_grp["ts"].min()
        days_since_first = (seed_time - first_order_ts).dt.days.rename("days_since_first_order")
        join_feature(days_since_first)
        order_freq = (total_orders / (days_since_first + 1)).rename("order_frequency")
        join_feature(order_freq)
        units_per_order = (total_units / total_orders.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0).rename("units_per_order")
        join_feature(units_per_order)
    else:
        for col in ["days_since_last_order", "days_since_first_order", "order_frequency", "units_per_order"]:
            features[col] = 0
    # 30-day window features
    thirty_days = pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    oi_30d = oi_hist[oi_hist["ts"] >= (seed_time - thirty_days)]
    oi_30d_grp = oi_30d.groupby("product_id")

    total_revenue_30d = oi_30d_grp["price"].sum().rename("total_revenue_30d")
    join_feature(total_revenue_30d)
    # 90-day window features
    ninety_days = pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    oi_90d = oi_hist[oi_hist["ts"] >= (seed_time - ninety_days)]
    oi_90d_grp = oi_90d.groupby("product_id")
    total_units_90d = oi_90d_grp.size().rename("total_units_90d")
    join_feature(total_units_90d)
    total_orders_90d = oi_90d_grp["order_id"].nunique().rename("total_orders_90d")
    join_feature(total_orders_90d)
    total_revenue_90d = oi_90d_grp["price"].sum().rename("total_revenue_90d")
    join_feature(total_revenue_90d)
    # Process reviews

    else:
        for col in ["unique_payment_types", "avg_payment_installments", "avg_payment_value", "total_payments"]:
            features[col] = 0

    if not orders_hist.empty and not oi_hist.empty:
        oi_orders = pd.merge(oi_hist, orders_hist, on="order_id", how="inner")
        # Delivered orders
        delivered_mask = oi_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"
        oi_delivered = oi_orders[delivered_mask].copy()
        oi_delivered_grp = oi_delivered.groupby("product_id")
        delivered_orders = oi_delivered_grp["order_id"].nunique().rename("delivered_orders")
        join_feature(delivered_orders)
        # Canceled orders
        canceled_mask = oi_orders["order_status"] == "canceled"
        oi_canceled = oi_orders[canceled_mask]
        oi_canceled_grp = oi_canceled.groupby("product_id")
        canceled_orders = oi_canceled_grp["order_id"].nunique().rename("canceled_orders")
        join_feature(canceled_orders)
        # Delivery metrics
        if not oi_delivered.empty:
            oi_delivered["delivery_days"] = (oi_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] - oi_delivered["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.days
            avg_delivery_days = oi_delivered.groupby("product_id")["delivery_days"].mean().rename("avg_delivery_days")
            join_feature(avg_delivery_days)
            oi_delivered["is_late"] = (oi_delivered["order_delivered_customer_date"] > oi_delivered["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).astype(int)
            late_count = oi_delivered.groupby("product_id")["is_late"].sum().rename("late_deliveries")
            join_feature(late_count)
            total_deliv = oi_delivered.groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique()
            late_rate = (late_count / total_deliv.replace(0, np.nan)).fillna(0).rename("late_delivery_rate")
            join_feature(late_rate)
        else:
            for col in ["avg_delivery_days", "late_deliveries", "late_delivery_rate"]:
                features[col] = 0
    else:
        for col in ["delivered_orders", "canceled_orders", "avg_delivery_days", "late_deliveries", "late_delivery_rate"]:
            features[col] = 0
    # Ensure all columns are numeric
    for col in features.columns:
        features[col] = pd.to_numeric(features[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    # Explicit reindex to match input entity_ids
    features = features.reindex(index=entity_ids)
    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Ensure seed_time is a pandas Timestamp
    seed_time = pd.to_datetime(seed_time)
    
    # Filter all tables to only include events before seed_time to avoid leakage
    orders_pre = db["orders"][db["orders"]["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
    order_items_pre = db["order_items"][db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    reviews_pre = db["reviews"][db["reviews"]["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    payments_pre = db["payments"][db["payments"]["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Helper function to compute product-level features from order items
    def compute_item_features(items_df: pd.DataFrame, suffix: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
        if items_df.empty:
            return pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"]).set_index("product_id")
        
        # Core aggregations
        core_agg = {
            "order_item_id": "count",
            "price": ["sum", "mean", "min", "max"],
            "freight_value": ["sum", "mean"],
            "order_id": "nunique",
            "seller_id": "nunique",
            "ts": ["min", "max"]
        }
        product_stats = items_df.groupby("product_id").agg(core_agg)
        product_stats.columns = ["_".join(col).strip() for col in product_stats.columns]
        
        # Rename columns to meaningful names
        rename_map = {
            "order_item_id_count": f"units_sold{suffix}",
            "price_sum": f"total_revenue{suffix}",
            "price_mean": f"avg_price{suffix}",
            "price_min": f"min_price{suffix}",
            "price_max": f"max_price{suffix}",
            "freight_value_sum": f"total_freight{suffix}",
            "freight_value_mean": f"avg_freight{suffix}",
            "order_id_nunique": f"orders_count{suffix}",
            "seller_id_nunique": f"sellers_count{suffix}",
            "ts_min": "first_sale_ts",
            "ts_max": "last_sale_ts"
        }
        product_stats = product_stats.rename(columns=rename_map)
        
        # Time-based features
        product_stats[f"days_since_first_sale{suffix}"] = (seed_time - product_stats["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        product_stats[f"days_since_last_sale{suffix}"] = (seed_time - product_stats["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        product_stats = product_stats.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])
        
        # Rolling window sales counts
        for days in [7, 14, 30, 60, 90]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=days)
            window_items = items_df[items_df["ts"] >= cutoff]
            window_sales = window_items.groupby("product_id")["order_item_id"].count()
            window_sales.name = f"sales_{days}d{suffix}"
            product_stats = product_stats.join(window_sales, how="left")
            product_stats[f"sales_{days}d{suffix}"] = product_stats[f"sales_{days}d{suffix}"].fillna(0).astype(np.int64)
        
        # Average time between sales
        sorted_items = items_df.sort_values(["product_id", "ts"])
        sorted_items["prev_ts"] = sorted_items.groupby("product_id")["ts"].shift(1)
        sorted_items["days_between"] = (sorted_items["ts"] - sorted_items["prev_ts"]).dt.days
        avg_gaps = sorted_items.groupby("product_id")["days_between"].mean()
        avg_gaps.name = f"avg_days_between_sales{suffix}"
        product_stats = product_stats.join(avg_gaps, how="left")
        # Fill with days since last sale for single-sale products (no gaps)
        product_stats[f"avg_days_between_sales{suffix}"] = product_stats[f"avg_days_between_sales{suffix}"].fillna(
            product_stats[f"days_since_last_sale{suffix}"]
        )
        
        return product_stats
    
    # Join order items with orders to filter by status
    items_orders = pd.merge(
        order_items_pre,
        orders_pre[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    all_items = items_orders.copy()
    delivered_items = items_orders[items_orders["order_status"] == "delivered"].copy()
    
    # Compute item-level features for all and delivered orders
    all_features = compute_item_features(all_items, "_all")
    delivered_features = compute_item_features(delivered_items, "_delivered")
    
    # Compute review features (link reviews to products via order items)
    reviews_with_products = pd.merge(
        reviews_pre[["order_id", "review_score", "review_creation_date"]],
        order_items_pre[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    if not reviews_with_products.empty:
        review_agg = reviews_with_products.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_reviews=pd.NamedAgg("review_score", "count"),
            avg_review_score=pd.NamedAgg("review_score", "mean"),
            min_review_score=pd.NamedAgg("review_score", "min"),
            max_review_score=pd.NamedAgg("review_score", "max")
        )
        # Add days since last review
        last_review = reviews_with_products.groupby("product_id")["review_creation_date"].max()
        review_agg["days_since_last_review"] = (seed_time - last_review).dt.days
    else:
        review_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            "total_reviews", "avg_review_score", "min_review_score",
            "max_review_score", "days_since_last_review"
        ])
        review_agg.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # Compute payment features (link order-level payments to products)
    if not payments_pre.empty:
        order_payments = payments_pre.groupby("order_id").agg(
            total_order_payment=pd.NamedAgg("payment_value", "sum"),
            num_payments=pd.NamedAgg("payment_sequential", "count"),
            avg_installments=pd.NamedAgg("payment_installments", "mean")
        ).reset_index()
        payments_products = pd.merge(
            order_payments,
            order_items_pre[["order_id", "product_id"]],
            on="order_id",
            how="inner"
        )
        payment_agg = payments_products.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_total_order_value=pd.NamedAgg("total_order_payment", "mean"),
            avg_payments_per_order=pd.NamedAgg("num_payments", "mean"),
            avg_installments_per_order=pd.NamedAgg("avg_installments", "mean")
        )
    else:
        payment_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            "avg_total_order_value", "avg_payments_per_order", "avg_installments_per_order"
        ])
        payment_agg.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # Compute delivery performance features (only for delivered orders)
    if not delivered_items.empty:
        delivered_full = pd.merge(
            delivered_items,
            orders_pre[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
            on="order_id",
            how="inner"
        )
        delivered_full["delivery_time_days"] = (
            delivered_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered_full["order_purchase_timestamp"]
        ).dt.days
        delivered_full["delivery_delay_days"] = (
            delivered_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - delivered_full["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
        ).dt.days
        
        delivery_agg = delivered_full.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_delivery_time=pd.NamedAgg("delivery_time_days", "mean"),
            min_delivery_time=pd.NamedAgg("delivery_time_days", "min"),
            max_delivery_time=pd.NamedAgg("delivery_time_days", "max"),
            avg_delivery_delay=pd.NamedAgg("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
            on_time_deliveries=pd.NamedAgg("delivery_delay_days", lambda x: (x <= 0).sum()),
            total_delivered_orders=pd.NamedAgg("order_id", "nunique")
        )
    else:
        delivery_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            "avg_delivery_time", "min_delivery_time", "max_delivery_time",
            "avg_delivery_delay", "on_time_deliveries", "total_delivered_orders"
        ])
        delivery_agg.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # Create base DataFrame with all requested product IDs
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    base.index.name = "product_id"
    
    # Merge all feature sets into base
    feature_sets = [all_features, delivered_features, review_agg, payment_agg, delivery_agg]
    for features in feature_sets:
        if not features.empty:
            base = base.join(features, how="left")
    
    # Identify column types for appropriate imputation
    count_cols = [col for col in base.columns if any(
        kw in col for kw in ["units_sold", "total_revenue", "total_freight", "orders_count", "sellers_count",
                              "sales_", "total_reviews", "on_time_deliveries", "total_delivered_orders", "num_payments"]
    )]
    numeric_cols = [col for col in base.columns if any(
        kw in col for kw in ["avg_", "min_", "max_", "price", "freight", "installments", "delay"]
    )]
    time_cols = [col for col in base.columns if any(
        kw in col for kw in ["days_since", "delivery_time", "avg_days_between"]
    )]
    
    # Impute missing values
    # Count columns: 0 (no events)
    for col in count_cols:
        if col in base.columns:
            base[col] = base[col].fillna(0).astype(np.int64)
    # Numeric value columns: 0 (no history to compute average)
    for col in numeric_cols:
        if col in base.columns:
            base[col] = base[col].fillna(0).astype(np.float64)
    # Time-based columns: large constant (1000 days, longer than dataset span) to indicate no history
    for col in time_cols:
        if col in base.columns:
            base[col] = base[col].fillna(1000).astype(np.float64)
    
    # Add explicit binary flags for easier model interpretation
    if "units_sold_all" in base.columns:
        base["has_ever_sold"] = (base["units_sold_all"] > 0).astype(np.int64)
    if "total_reviews" in base.columns:
        base["has_reviews"] = (base["total_reviews"] > 0).astype(np.int64)
    
    # Ensure final index matches input entity_ids exactly (no extra rows)
    base = base.reindex(entity_ids)
    base.index.name = "product_id"
    
    return base

    # Initialize result DataFrame with requested product IDs

    ).reset_index()
    
    # Compute time-based features from purchase timestamps
    oi_agg["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - oi_agg["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    oi_agg["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - oi_agg["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    oi_agg["avg_units_per_order"] = oi_agg["total_units"] / oi_agg["total_orders"].replace(0, np.nan)
    
    # Drop intermediate timestamp columns
    oi_agg = oi_agg.drop(columns=["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts"])
    
    # Merge to result
    result = result.merge(oi_agg, on="product_id", how="left")

    payment_type_ratios = payment_type_counts.div(total_transactions, axis=0).fillna(0)
    payment_type_ratios.columns = [f"ratio_{col}" for col in payment_type_ratios.columns]
    payment_type_ratios = payment_type_ratios.reset_index()
    
    # Merge payment aggregates and ratios
    payment_agg = payment_agg.merge(payment_type_ratios, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Merge to result
    result = result.merge(payment_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # --------------------------
    # Finalize result DataFrame

    # Set index to product ID and reindex to match input entity_ids exactly
    result = result.set_index("product_id")

    result = result.fillna(0)

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Извлекаем таблицы
    orders = db['orders']
    order_items = db['order_items']
    reviews = db['reviews']
    payments = db['payments']
    
    # Приводим entity_ids к списку
    entity_ids = list(entity_ids)
    
    # Базовый DataFrame с индексом product_id
    features = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    
    # 1. Фильтруем order_items по времени и товарам
    mask_items = (order_items['product_id'].isin(entity_ids)) & (order_items['ts'] < seed_time)
    items = order_items.loc[mask_items].copy()
    
    if not items.empty:
        # Агрегаты из order_items
        agg_items = items.groupby('product_id').agg(
            num_items=('order_id', 'count'),
            num_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            num_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
            total_price=('price', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            first_ts=('ts', 'min'),
            last_ts=('ts', 'max'),
        )
        # Временные признаки
        agg_items['days_since_last'] = (seed_time - agg_items['last_ts']).dt.days
        agg_items['product_age_days'] = (seed_time - agg_items['first_ts']).dt.days
        
        # Заказы за последние 30/90/180 дней
        for window in [30, 90, 180]:
            cutoff = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
            cnt = items.loc[items['ts'] >= cutoff].groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            agg_items[f'num_orders_{window}d'] = cnt
        agg_items = agg_items.fillna(0)
        features = features.join(agg_items, how='left')
        
        # 2. Признаки из orders (доставка)
        # Присоединяем orders к items
        items_with_orders = items.merge(
            orders[['order_id', 'order_purchase_timestamp', 'order_estimated_delivery_date', 'order_delivered_customer_date', 'customer_id']],
            on='order_id',
            how='left'
        )
        
        # Плановая длительность доставки
        items_with_orders['est_delivery_days'] = (
            items_with_orders['order_estimated_delivery_date'] - items_with_orders['order_purchase_timestamp']
        ).dt.days
        est_agg = items_with_orders.groupby('product_id')['est_delivery_days'].agg(
            avg_est_delivery_days='mean',
            median_est_delivery_days='median',
            std_est_delivery_days='std'
        )
        features = features.join(est_agg, how='left')
        
        # Фактическая длительность для доставленных до seed_time
        delivered = items_with_orders[items_with_orders['order_delivered_customer_date'] < seed_time]
        if not delivered.empty:
            delivered = delivered.copy()
            delivered['actual_delivery_days'] = (
                delivered['order_delivered_customer_date'] - delivered['order_purchase_timestamp']
            ).dt.days
            act_agg = delivered.groupby('product_id')['actual_delivery_days'].agg(
                avg_actual_delivery_days='mean',
                median_actual_delivery_days='median',
                std_actual_delivery_days='std'
            )
            act_agg['num_delivered'] = delivered.groupby('product_id')['order_id'].nunique()
            features = features.join(act_agg, how='left')
        
        # Количество уникальных клиентов
        cust_agg = items_with_orders.groupby('product_id')['customer_id'].nunique().rename('num_customers')
        features = features.join(cust_agg, how='left')
        
        # 3. Признаки из payments
        order_ids = items['order_id'].unique()
        payments_filtered = payments[(payments['order_id'].isin(order_ids)) & (payments['ts'] < seed_time)]
        if not payments_filtered.empty:
            payments_items = payments_filtered.merge(items[['order_id', 'product_id']], on='order_id')
            pay_agg = payments_items.groupby('product_id').agg(
                total_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
                avg_payment=('payment_value', 'mean'),
                num_payments=('payment_value', 'count'),
                avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
                credit_card_share=('payment_type', lambda x: (x == 'credit_card').mean())
            )
            features = features.join(pay_agg, how='left')
        
        # 4. Признаки из reviews
        reviews_filtered = reviews[(reviews['order_id'].isin(order_ids)) & (reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time)]
        if not reviews_filtered.empty:
            reviews_items = reviews_filtered.merge(items[['order_id', 'product_id']], on='order_id')
            rev_agg = reviews_items.groupby('product_id').agg(
                avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
                num_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
                min_review_score=('review_score', 'min'),
                max_review_score=('review_score', 'max'),
                positive_share=('review_score', lambda x: (x >= 4).mean())
            )
            features = features.join(rev_agg, how='left')
    
    # Заполняем пропуски нулями (товары без истории)
    features = features.fillna(0)
    
    # Реиндексируем по entity_ids (гарантируем порядок)
    features = features.reindex(entity_ids)
    
    return features

        "payment_type_nunique": "num_payment_types"
    })
    # Merge payment features into core features
    core_features = core_features.merge(payment_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    # --------------------------
    # 5. Finalize Feature Set
    # --------------------------
    # Create base DataFrame with all requested entity IDs
    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids}).set_index("product_id")

    final = final.drop(columns=["last_purchase_ts", "first_purchase_ts"])

    final[count_cols] = final[count_cols].fillna(0)

    final["recency_days"] = final["recency_days"].fillna(1000)
    # Set tenure to 0 for products with no history
    final["tenure_days"] = final["tenure_days"].fillna(0)
    # Fill remaining NaN values with 0
    final = final.fillna(0)
    # Ensure exact index matching input entity IDs
    final = final.reindex(entity_ids)

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Extract tables from database
    orders = db["orders"].copy()
    order_items = db["order_items"].copy()
    reviews = db["reviews"].copy()
    payments = db["payments"].copy()
    
    # --------------------------
    # Step 1: Prepare valid order items (non-canceled, before seed_time)
    # --------------------------
    # Filter order items to events strictly before seed_time
    order_items_filtered = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    # Join with orders to get status, filter out canceled/unavailable orders
    order_items_valid = pd.merge(
        left=order_items_filtered,
        right=orders[["order_id", "order_status"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    order_items_valid = order_items_valid[
        ~order_items_valid["order_status"].isin(["canceled", "unavailable"])
    ].copy()
    
    # Define time windows
    delta_30d = pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    delta_90d = pd.Timedelta(days=90)
    mask_30d = order_items_valid["ts"] >= (seed_time - delta_30d)
    mask_90d = order_items_valid["ts"] >= (seed_time - delta_90d)
    
    # --------------------------
    # Step 2: Aggregate sales/order item features
    # --------------------------
    # All-time aggregations
    agg_all = {
        "order_item_id": "count",
        "price": ["sum", "mean"],
        "freight_value": ["sum", "mean"],
        "ts": ["min", "max"]
    }
    grp_all = order_items_valid.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_all)
    grp_all.columns = ["_".join(col).strip() for col in grp_all.columns.values]
    grp_all = grp_all.rename(columns={
        "order_item_id_count": "total_units_all_time",
        "price_sum": "total_price_all_time",
        "price_mean": "avg_price_all_time",
        "freight_value_sum": "total_freight_all_time",
        "freight_value_mean": "avg_freight_all_time",
        "ts_min": "first_purchase_ts",
        "ts_max": "last_purchase_ts"
    })
    grp_all["total_revenue_all_time"] = grp_all["total_price_all_time"] + grp_all["total_freight_all_time"]
    grp_all["days_since_last_order"] = (seed_time - grp_all["last_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    grp_all["days_since_first_order"] = (seed_time - grp_all["first_purchase_ts"]).dt.days
    grp_all = grp_all.drop(columns=[
        "total_price_all_time", "total_freight_all_time",
        "first_purchase_ts", "last_purchase_ts"
    ])
    
    # 90-day window aggregations
    agg_90 = {
        "order_item_id": "count",
        "price": "sum",
        "freight_value": "sum"
    }
    grp_90 = order_items_valid[mask_90d].groupby("product_id").agg(agg_90)
    grp_90.columns = ["_".join(col).strip() for col in grp_90.columns.values]
    grp_90 = grp_90.rename(columns={
        "order_item_id_count": "total_units_90d",
        "price_sum": "total_price_90d",
        "freight_value_sum": "total_freight_90d"
    })
    grp_90["total_revenue_90d"] = grp_90["total_price_90d"] + grp_90["total_freight_90d"]
    grp_90 = grp_90.drop(columns=["total_price_90d", "total_freight_90d"])
    
    # 30-day window aggregations
    agg_30 = {
        "order_item_id": "count",
        "price": "sum",
        "freight_value": "sum"
    }
    grp_30 = order_items_valid[mask_30d].groupby("product_id").agg(agg_30)
    grp_30.columns = ["_".join(col).strip() for col in grp_30.columns.values]
    grp_30 = grp_30.rename(columns={
        "order_item_id_count": "total_units_30d",
        "price_sum": "total_price_30d",
        "freight_value_sum": "total_freight_30d"
    })
    grp_30["total_revenue_30d"] = grp_30["total_price_30d"] + grp_30["total_freight_30d"]
    grp_30 = grp_30.drop(columns=["total_price_30d", "total_freight_30d"])
    
    # --------------------------
    # Step 3: Aggregate review features
    # --------------------------
    # Filter reviews to before seed_time and valid orders
    reviews_filtered = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    valid_order_ids = order_items_valid["order_id"].unique()
    reviews_valid = reviews_filtered[reviews_filtered["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids)].copy()
    # Link reviews to product IDs via order items
    reviews_with_products = pd.merge(
        left=reviews_valid,
        right=order_items_valid[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Flag positive/negative reviews
    reviews_with_products["is_positive"] = (reviews_with_products["review_score"] >= 4).astype(int)
    reviews_with_products["is_negative"] = (reviews_with_products["review_score"] <= 2).astype(int)
    
    # Core review aggregations
    agg_reviews = {
        "review_id": "nunique",
        "review_score": "mean",
        "review_creation_date": "max"
    }
    grp_reviews = reviews_with_products.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_reviews)
    grp_reviews.columns = ["_".join(col).strip() for col in grp_reviews.columns.values]
    grp_reviews = grp_reviews.rename(columns={
        "review_id_nunique": "total_reviews_all_time",
        "review_score_mean": "avg_review_score_all_time",
        "review_creation_date_max": "last_review_ts"
    })
    # Count positive/negative unique reviews
    positive_revs = reviews_with_products[reviews_with_products["is_positive"] == 1].groupby("product_id")["review_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="total_positive_reviews")
    negative_revs = reviews_with_products[reviews_with_products["is_negative"] == 1].groupby("product_id")["review_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="total_negative_reviews")
    grp_reviews = pd.merge(grp_reviews, positive_revs, on="product_id", how="left")

    feat["total_orders"] = grp["order_id"].nunique()
    feat["total_items"] = grp.size()
    feat["sum_price"] = grp["price"].sum()
    feat["avg_price"] = grp["price"].mean()
    feat["sum_freight"] = grp["freight_value"].sum()
    feat["avg_freight"] = grp["freight_value"].mean()
    feat["unique_sellers"] = grp["seller_id"].nunique()
    feat["unique_customers"] = grp["customer_id"].nunique()

    feat["first_order_ts"] = grp["ts"].min()

    feat["days_since_first_order"] = (seed_time - feat["first_order_ts"]).dt.days
    feat["order_frequency"] = feat["total_orders"] / (feat["days_since_first_order"] + 1)

            feat[f"sum_price_last_{window}d"] = 0

    payments_before = payments[
        (payments["ts"] < seed_time) &
        (payments["order_id"].isin(relevant_order_ids))
    ].copy()
    
    # Define time windows for recency features
    time_windows = {
        "30d": pd.Timedelta(days=30),
        "90d": pd.Timedelta(days=90),
        "180d": pd.Timedelta(days=180),
        "365d": pd.Timedelta(days=365)
    }
    
    # 1. Aggregate all-time order items features
    agg_all_time = oi_before.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_all=("order_item_id", "count"),
        total_revenue_all=("price", "sum"),
        total_freight_all=("freight_value", "sum"),
        avg_price_all=("price", "mean"),
        first_sale_ts=("ts", "min"),
        last_sale_ts=("ts", "max"),
        unique_sellers_all=("seller_id", "nunique")
    ).reset_index()
    
    # Calculate days since first/last sale
    agg_all_time["days_since_first_sale"] = (seed_time - agg_all_time["first_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    agg_all_time["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - agg_all_time["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    agg_all_time.drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"], inplace=True)
    
    # 2. Aggregate windowed order items features
    windowed_dfs = [agg_all_time]
    for win_name, win_delta in time_windows.items():
        win_start = seed_time - win_delta
        oi_window = oi_before[oi_before["ts"] >= win_start]
        agg_win = oi_window.groupby("product_id").agg(
            **{
                f"total_units_{win_name}": ("order_item_id", "count"),
                f"total_revenue_{win_name}": ("price", "sum"),
                f"total_freight_{win_name}": ("freight_value", "sum"),
                f"avg_price_{win_name}": ("price", "mean"),
                f"unique_sellers_{win_name}": ("seller_id", "nunique")
            }
        ).reset_index()
        windowed_dfs.append(agg_win)

    oi_orders_joined = pd.merge(oi_before, orders_before, on="order_id", how="left")

    oi_orders_joined["delivery_delay_days"] = (

    ).dt.total_seconds() / (3600 * 24
    oi_orders_joined["approval_delay_days"] = (

    ).dt.total_seconds() / (3600 * 24

        avg_delivery_delay_days=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),
        avg_approval_delay_days=("approval_delay_days", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    windowed_dfs.append(order_features)
    
    # 4. Review features
    oi_reviews_joined = pd.merge(
        oi_before[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        reviews_before,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    review_features = oi_reviews_joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=("review_id", "nunique"),
        avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    windowed_dfs.append(review_features)
    
    # 5. Payment features
    oi_payments_joined = pd.merge(
        oi_before[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates(),
        payments_before,
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    payment_features = oi_payments_joined.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payments=("payment_sequential", "count"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        avg_payment_value=("payment_value", "mean")
    ).reset_index()
    windowed_dfs.append(payment_features)
    
    # Combine all features into single DataFrame
    base_df = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids})
    features_df = base_df.copy()
    for df in windowed_dfs:
        features_df = pd.merge(features_df, df, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Clean up missing values and create final formatting
    # Fill numeric NaNs with 0; for days since sales, set NaN (no sales) to large value (10000 days ~27 years
    numeric_cols = features_df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
    features_df[numeric_cols] = features_df[numeric_cols] = features_df[numeric_cols].fillna(0)
    days_cols = [c for c in features_df.columns if "days_since" in c]
    features_df[days_cols] = features_df[days_cols].replace(0, 10000)  # No sales means very long time since last sale
    # Add flag for any prior sales
    features_df["has_prior_sales"] = (features_df["total_units_all"] > 0).astype(int)
    
    # Ensure final reindex to entity_ids
    features_df = features_df.set_index("product_id")
    features_df = features_df.reindex(entity_ids)
    features_df = features_df.fillna(0)
    
    # Ensure all columns are numeric
    for col in features_df.columns:
        features_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(features_df[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    
    return features_df

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Initialize base DataFrame with exact entity_ids index (preserves order/duplicates)
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    base.index.name = 'product_id'
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Sales Features from order_items
    # --------------------------
    oi = db['order_items'].copy()
    # Filter to only events strictly before seed_time
    oi_pre = oi[oi['ts'] < seed_time]
    
    if not oi_pre.empty:
        # Aggregate core sales metrics per product
        oi_agg = oi_pre.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_units_sold=('order_item_id', 'count'),
            total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
            total_revenue=('price', 'sum'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
            avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
            avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
            last_sale_ts=('ts', 'max'),
            first_sale_ts=('ts', 'min')
        ).reset_index()
        
        # Calculate time-based features (convert to days)
        oi_agg['days_since_last_sale'] = (seed_time - oi_agg['last_sale_ts']).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        oi_agg['days_since_first_sale'] = (seed_time - oi_agg['first_sale_ts']).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
        
        # Drop raw timestamp columns
        oi_agg = oi_agg.drop(columns=['last_sale_ts', 'first_sale_ts'])
    else:
        # Create empty aggregate DataFrame with matching columns
        oi_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            'product_id', 'total_units_sold', 'total_orders',
            'total_revenue', 'total_freight', 'avg_price', 'avg_freight',
            'days_since_last_sale', 'days_since_first_sale'
        ])
    
    # Merge sales features into base
    base = base.merge(oi_agg.set_index('product_id'), left_index=True, right_index=True, how='left')
    
    # Add sales indicator and fill NaNs
    base['has_pre_sales'] = (~base['total_orders'].isna()).astype(int)
    # Fill count/sum columns with 0
    count_cols = ['total_units_sold', 'total_orders', 'total_revenue', 'total_freight']
    avg_cols = ['avg_price', 'avg_freight']
    base[count_cols] = base[count_cols].fillna(0)
    base[avg_cols] = base[avg_cols].fillna(0)
    # Fill time columns: large value for never sold, 0 for undefined first sale
    base['days_since_last_sale'] = base['days_since_last_sale'].fillna(730)  # 2 years proxy
    base['days_since_first_sale'] = base['days_since_first_sale'].fillna(0)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Review Features
    # --------------------------
    reviews = db['reviews'].copy()
    # Filter reviews created strictly before seed_time
    reviews_pre = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time]
    
    if not reviews_pre.empty and not oi_pre.empty:
        # Link reviews to products via order_id (only pre-seed orders)
        review_product = reviews_pre.merge(oi_pre[['order_id', 'product_id']], on='order_id', how='inner')
        # Aggregate review metrics per product
        review_agg = review_product.groupby('product_id').agg(
            total_reviews=('review_id', 'count'),
            avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
            min_review_score=('review_score', 'min'),
            max_review_score=('review_score', 'max'),
            total_comment_titles=('review_comment_title', lambda x: x.notna().sum()),
            total_comment_messages=('review_comment_message', lambda x: x.notna().sum())
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        # Empty aggregate DataFrame
        review_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            'product_id', 'total_reviews', 'avg_review_score',
            'min_review_score', 'max_review_score',
            'total_comment_titles', 'total_comment_messages'
        ])
    
    # Merge review features into base
    base = base.merge(review_agg.set_index('product_id'), left_index=True, right_index=True, how='left')
    
    # Fill NaNs for review features
    review_count_cols = ['total_reviews', 'total_comment_titles', 'total_comment_messages']
    review_score_cols = ['avg_review_score', 'min_review_score', 'max_review_score']
    base[review_count_cols] = base[review_count_cols].fillna(0)
    base[review_score_cols] = base[review_score_cols].fillna(0)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Payment Features
    # --------------------------
    payments = db['payments'].copy()
    # Filter payments made strictly before seed_time
    payments_pre = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time]
    
    if not payments_pre.empty:
        # Aggregate payment metrics per order first
        order_payment_agg = payments_pre.groupby('order_id').agg(
            total_order_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
            num_payments=('payment_sequential', 'count'),
            avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean'),
            max_installments=('payment_installments', 'max')
        ).reset_index()
    else:
        order_payment_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=[
            'order_id', 'total_order_payment', 'num_payments',
            'avg_installments', 'max_installments'
        ])
    
    # Link order-level payments to products
    if not oi_pre.empty and not order_payment_agg.empty:
        # Join payments with order items
        product_payment = oi_pre[['order_id', 'product_id', 'price', 'freight_value']].merge(
            order_payment_agg, on='order_id', how='inner'
        )
        # Calculate order total from items for proportional allocation
        order_item_totals = oi_pre.groupby('order_id').agg(
            total_price=('price', 'sum'),
            total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum')
        ).reset_index()
        order_item_totals['order_item_total'] = order_item_totals['total_price'] + order_item_totals['total_freight']
        order_item_totals = order_item_totals[['order_id', 'order_item_total']]
        
        # Merge totals and allocate payment to product
        product_payment = product_payment.merge(order_item_totals, on='order_id', how='left')
        # Avoid division by zero: replace 0 total with inf to get 0 share
        product_payment['product_share'] = (product_payment['price'] + product_payment['freight_value']) / product_payment['order_item_total'].replace(0, np.inf)
        product_payment['allocated_payment'] = product_payment['total_order_payment'] * product_payment['product_share']

        ).reset_index()
    else:
        payment_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=[

        ])

    base = base.merge(payment_agg.set_index('product_id'), left_index=True, right_index=True, how='left')

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Initialize base DataFrame with all requested entity IDs
    base = pd.DataFrame({"product_id": entity_ids})
    
    # Step 1: Filter valid order items (before seed_time)
    valid_order_items = db["order_items"][db["order_items"]["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    product_order_map = valid_order_items[["product_id", "order_id"]].drop_duplicates().copy()
    
    # Initialize order_item_agg to avoid merging errors
    order_item_agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id", "total_units", "total_orders", "total_revenue",
                                            "total_freight", "avg_price", "avg_freight", "days_since_first_order",
                                            "days_since_last_order", "has_past_sales", "count_orders_last_7d",
                                            "count_orders_last_30d", "count_orders_last_90d", "ratio_last_30d_to_total",
                                            "ratio_last_90d_to_total"])
    
    if not valid_order_items.empty:
        # Aggregate core order item metrics
        order_item_agg = valid_order_items.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_units=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
            total_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
            total_revenue=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="sum"),
            total_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum"),
            avg_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="mean"),
            avg_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="mean"),
            min_order_ts=pd.NamedAgg(column="ts", aggfunc="min"),
            max_order_ts=pd.NamedAgg(column="ts", aggfunc="max")
        ).reset_index()
        
        # Calculate time-based features
        order_item_agg["days_since_first_order"] = (seed_time - order_item_agg["min_order_ts"]).dt.days
        order_item_agg["days_since_last_order"] = (seed_time - order_item_agg["max_order_ts"]).dt.days
        order_item_agg["has_past_sales"] = 1
        order_item_agg = order_item_agg.drop(columns=["min_order_ts", "max_order_ts"])
        
        # Add recent order counts (7, 30, 90 day windows)
        last_7d = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=7)
        last_30d = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
        last_90d = seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)
        
        recent_agg = valid_order_items[valid_order_items["ts"] >= last_7d].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="count_orders_last_7d")
        month_agg = valid_order_items[valid_order_items["ts"] >= last_30d].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="count_orders_last_30d")
        qtr_agg = valid_order_items[valid_order_items["ts"] >= last_90d].groupby("product_id")["order_id"].nunique().reset_index(name="count_orders_last_90d")
        
        # Merge recent metrics
        order_item_agg = order_item_agg.merge(recent_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        order_item_agg = order_item_agg.merge(month_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        order_item_agg = order_item_agg.merge(qtr_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
        
        # Fill NaN in recent counts
        for col in ["count_orders_last_7d", "count_orders_last_30d", "count_orders_last_90d"]:
            order_item_agg[col] = order_item_agg[col].fillna(0).astype(np.int64)
        
        # Add ratio features
        order_item_agg["ratio_last_30d_to_total"] = order_item_agg["count_orders_last_30d"] / (order_item_agg["total_orders"] + 1e-9)
        order_item_agg["ratio_last_90d_to_total"] = order_item_agg["count_orders_last_90d"] / (order_item_agg["total_orders"] + 1e-9)
        
        # Step 2: Add order status features
        valid_orders = db["orders"][db["orders"]["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time].copy()
        order_status = product_order_map.merge(valid_orders[["order_id", "order_status"]], on="order_id", how="left").drop_duplicates()
        
        # Pivot status to columns
        status_pivot = order_status.groupby(["product_id", "order_status"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0).reset_index()
        status_pivot.columns = [f"count_orders_{col}" if col!= "product_id" else col for col in status_pivot.columns]
        
        # Merge status features
        order_item_agg = order_item_agg.merge(status_pivot, on="product_id", how="left")
        # Fill missing status columns with 0
        for col in status_pivot.columns:
            if col.startswith("count_orders_"):
                order_item_agg[col] = order_item_agg[col].fillna(0).astype(np.int64)
        
        # Add cancellation ratio
        if "count_orders_canceled" in order_item_agg.columns:
            order_item_agg["ratio_canceled_orders"] = order_item_agg["count_orders_canceled"] / (order_item_agg["total_orders"] + 1e-9)
        else:
            order_item_agg["ratio_canceled_orders"] = 0.0
        
        # Step 3: Add time between orders features
        oi_sorted = valid_order_items.sort_values(by=["product_id", "ts"]).reset_index(drop=True)
        oi_sorted["prev_ts"] = oi_sorted.groupby("product_id")["ts"].shift(1)
        oi_sorted["days_between"] = (oi_sorted["ts"] - oi_sorted["prev_ts"]).dt.days
        
        time_agg = oi_sorted.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_days_between_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="days_between", aggfunc="mean"),
            std_days_between_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="days_between", aggfunc="std"),
            max_days_between_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="days_between", aggfunc="max")
        ).reset_index()
        
        order_item_agg = order_item_agg.merge(time_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Step 4: Add payment features
    payment_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])
    if not product_order_map.empty:
        valid_order_ids = product_order_map["order_id"].unique()
        valid_payments = db["payments"][(db["payments"]["ts"] < seed_time) & (db["payments"]["order_id"].isin(valid_order_ids))].copy()
        
        if not valid_payments.empty:
            # Aggregate per order first
            order_pay_agg = valid_payments.groupby("order_id").agg(
                total_payment_order=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="sum"),
                avg_installment_order=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="mean"),
                max_installment_order=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="max")
            ).reset_index()
            
            # Map to products
            product_pay = product_order_map.merge(order_pay_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
            product_pay_agg = product_pay.groupby("product_id").agg(
                total_order_payment_sum=pd.NamedAgg(column="total_payment_order", aggfunc="sum"),
                total_order_payment_mean=pd.NamedAgg(column="total_payment_order", aggfunc="mean"),
                total_order_payment_std=pd.NamedAgg(column="total_payment_order", aggfunc="std"),
                avg_installment_mean=pd.NamedAgg(column="avg_installment_order", aggfunc="mean"),
                max_installment_max=pd.NamedAgg(column="max_installment_order", aggfunc="max")
            ).reset_index()
            
            # Payment type counts
            pay_type = valid_payments[["order_id", "payment_type"]].merge(product_order_map, on="order_id", how="left")
            pay_type_dummies = pd.get_dummies(pay_type, columns=["payment_type"], prefix="pay_type")
            pay_type_agg = pay_type_dummies.groupby("product_id").sum(numeric_only=True).reset_index()
            pay_type_agg.columns = [col.replace("pay_type_", "count_pay_") if col!= "product_id" else col for col in pay_type_agg.columns]
            
            # Merge payment features
            payment_features = product_pay_agg.merge(pay_type_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Step 5: Add review features
    review_features = pd.DataFrame(columns=["product_id"])
    if not product_order_map.empty:
        valid_reviews = db["reviews"][db["reviews"]["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
        
        if not valid_reviews.empty:
            # Map reviews to products
            product_reviews = product_order_map.merge(valid_reviews[["order_id", "review_score"]], on="order_id", how="left")
            
            # Core review metrics
            review_agg = product_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
                total_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="count"),
                avg_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="mean"),
                std_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="std"),
                min_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="min"),
                max_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="max")
            ).reset_index()
            
            # Sentiment metrics
            product_reviews["is_positive"] = (product_reviews["review_score"] >= 4).astype(np.int64)
            product_reviews["is_negative"] = (product_reviews["review_score"] <= 2).astype(np.int64)
            sentiment_agg = product_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
                count_positive_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="is_positive", aggfunc="sum"),
                count_negative_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="is_negative", aggfunc="sum")
            ).reset_index()
            
            # Combine review features
            review_features = review_agg.merge(sentiment_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
            review_features["has_reviews"] = 1
    
    # Merge all features into base DataFrame
    features = base.merge(order_item_agg, on="product_id", how="left")
    features = features.merge(payment_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    features = features.merge(review_features, on="product_id", how="left")
    
    # Fill missing values
    large_days = (seed_time - pd.Timestamp("2000-01-01")).days
    
    # Binary flags
    binary_cols = ["has_past_sales", "has_reviews"]
    for col in binary_cols:
        features[col] = features[col].fillna(0).astype(np.int8) if col in features.columns else 0
    
    # Count columns
    count_cols = [c for c in features.columns if "count" in c.lower() or c in ["total_units", "total_orders", "total_revenue", "total_freight", "total_reviews", "total_order_payment_sum"]]
    for col in count_cols:
        if col in features.columns:
            features[col] = features[col].fillna(0).astype(np.int64)
    
    # Remaining numeric columns
    for col in features.columns:
        if col not in ["product_id"] + binary_cols + count_cols:
            if "days_since" in col or "days_between" in col:
                features[col] = features[col].fillna(large_days)
            else:
                features[col] = features[col].fillna(0.0)
    
    # Set index to entity IDs and reindex to ensure correct order/presence
    features = features.set_index("product_id").reindex(entity_ids)
    return features

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Initialize base DataFrame indexed by entity_ids
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Process order_items (direct product link)
    # --------------------------
    oi = db["order_items"].copy()
    oi_filtered = oi[oi["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # All-time aggregations
    oi_agg_all = oi_filtered.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_units_sold=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
        total_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="sum"),
        total_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum"),
        avg_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="mean"),
        avg_freight=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        total_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
        unique_sellers=pd.NamedAgg(column="seller_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
        max_sale_ts=pd.NamedAgg(column="ts", aggfunc="max")
    )
    oi_agg_all["total_revenue"] = oi_agg_all["total_price"] + oi_agg_all["total_freight"]
    oi_agg_all["last_sale_days"] = (seed_time - oi_agg_all["max_sale_ts"]).dt.days
    oi_agg_all = oi_agg_all.drop(columns=["max_sale_ts", "total_price", "total_freight"])
    
    # Time-windowed aggregations (30d, 90d, 180d)
    time_windows = [
        ("30d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("180d", seed_time - pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
    ]
    oi_window_aggs = []
    for suffix, window_start in time_windows:
        oi_window = oi_filtered[oi_filtered["ts"] >= window_start]
        agg = oi_window.groupby("product_id").agg(**{
            f"total_units_{suffix}": pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
            f"total_price_win": pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="sum"),
            f"total_freight_win": pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum"),
            f"total_orders_{suffix}": pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
        })
        agg[f"total_revenue_{suffix}"] = agg[f"total_price_win"] + agg[f"total_freight_win"]
        agg = agg.drop(columns=[f"total_price_win", f"total_freight_win"])
        oi_window_aggs.append(agg)
    
    # Combine order_items features
    oi_features = oi_agg_all
    for agg in oi_window_aggs:
        oi_features = oi_features.join(agg, how="outer")
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Process orders (join via order_items)
    # --------------------------
    relevant_order_ids = oi_filtered["order_id"].unique()
    orders = db["orders"].copy()
    orders_filtered = orders[
        (orders["order_id"].isin(relevant_order_ids)) &
        (orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()
    
    # Create product-order mapping
    order_product = oi_filtered[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        orders_filtered, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    
    # Derive order metrics
    order_product["delivery_days"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["approval_days"] = (
        order_product["order_approved_at"] - order_product["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.days
    order_product["is_late"] = (
        order_product["order_delivered_customer_date"] > order_product["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).astype(int)
    
    # Aggregate order metrics per product
    order_agg = order_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_delivered_orders=pd.NamedAgg(
            column="order_status", aggfunc=lambda x: (x == "delivered").sum()
        ),
        total_canceled_orders=pd.NamedAgg(
            column="order_status", aggfunc=lambda x: (x == "canceled").sum()
        ),
        avg_delivery_days=pd.NamedAgg(column="delivery_days", aggfunc="mean"),
        avg_approval_days=pd.NamedAgg(column="approval_days", aggfunc="mean"),
        total_late_deliveries=pd.NamedAgg(column="is_late", aggfunc="sum"),
    )
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Process reviews (join via order_items)
    # --------------------------
    reviews = db["reviews"].copy()
    reviews_filtered = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Create product-review mapping
    review_product = oi_filtered[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        reviews_filtered, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    
    # Aggregate review metrics per product
    review_agg = review_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_id", aggfunc="count"),
        avg_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="mean"),
        min_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="min"),
        max_review_score=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc="max"),
        low_review_count=pd.NamedAgg(
            column="review_score", aggfunc=lambda x: (x <= 2).sum()
        ),
    )
    
    # --------------------------
    # 4. Process payments (join via order_items)
    # --------------------------
    payments = db["payments"].copy()
    payments_filtered = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # Create product-payment mapping
    payment_product = oi_filtered[["order_id", "product_id"]].drop_duplicates().merge(
        payments_filtered, on="order_id", how="inner"
    )
    
    # Aggregate payment metrics per product
    payment_agg = payment_product.groupby("product_id").agg(
        total_payment_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="sum"),
        avg_payment_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="mean"),
        avg_payment_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="mean"),
        unique_payment_types=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_type", aggfunc="nunique"),
    )
    
    # Add payment type counts
    payment_type_counts = payment_product.groupby(["product_id", "payment_type"]).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    payment_type_counts.columns = [f"payment_type_{col}" for col in payment_type_counts.columns]
    payment_agg = payment_agg.join(payment_type_counts, how="outer")
    
    # --------------------------
    # Combine all features
    # --------------------------
    # Add history flag
    has_history = pd.Series(
        index=entity_ids,
        data=[1 if pid in oi_filtered["product_id"].values else 0 for pid in entity_ids],
        name="has_history"
    )
    
    # Join all feature groups to base
    features = base.join(oi_features, how="left")
    features = features.join(order_agg, how="left")
    features = features.join(review_agg, how="left")
    features = features.join(payment_agg, how="left")
    features = features.join(has_history, how="left")
    
    # --------------------------
    # Handle missing values
    # --------------------------
    # Special handling for last_sale_days: set to large value if never sold
    if "last_sale_days" in features.columns:
        features["last_sale_days"] = features["last_sale_days"].fillna(9999)
    # Fill all other numeric NaNs with 0 (no data = 0 counts/values)
    numeric_cols = features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns
    cols_to_fill = [col for col in numeric_cols if col != "last_sale_days"]
    features[cols_to_fill] = features[cols_to_fill].fillna(0)
    
    # Ensure index matches input entity_ids exactly
    features = features.reindex(index=entity_ids)
    
    return features
