    oi_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    if not oi_hist.empty:
        oi_agg = oi_hist.groupby("product_id").agg(
            total_units_sold=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_item_id", aggfunc="count"),
            total_unique_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_id", aggfunc="nunique"),
            total_product_revenue=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="sum"),
            total_shipping_cost=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="sum"),
            avg_unit_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="mean"),
            avg_shipping_per_unit=pd.NamedAgg(column="freight_value", aggfunc="mean"),
            max_unit_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="max"),
            min_unit_price=pd.NamedAgg(column="price", aggfunc="min"),
            unique_sellers=pd.NamedAgg(column="seller_id", aggfunc="nunique")
        )
        # Merge with base features
        features = features.join(oi_agg, how="left")
    else:
        # Initialize empty columns if no historical data
        oi_cols = [
            "total_units_sold", "total_unique_orders", "total_product_revenue",
            "total_shipping_cost", "avg_unit_price", "avg_shipping_per_unit",
            "max_unit_price", "min_unit_price", "unique_sellers"
        ]
        for col in oi_cols:
            features[col] = np.nan

    # 3. Order Status Aggregates (fulfillment metrics)
    # --------------------------
    # Filter orders to historical purchases
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < seed_time][["order_id", "order_status"]].copy()
    if not oi_hist.empty and not orders_hist.empty:
        # Link order status to products
        order_product_status = oi_hist.merge(orders_hist, on="order_id", how="inner")
        # Deduplicate to avoid counting multiple items in the same order
        order_product_status_dedup = order_product_status[["order_id", "product_id", "order_status"]].drop_duplicates()
        status_agg = order_product_status_dedup.groupby("product_id").agg(
            delivered_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_status", aggfunc=lambda s: (s == "delivered").sum()),
            canceled_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_status", aggfunc=lambda s: (s == "canceled").sum()),
            shipped_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_status", aggfunc=lambda s: (s == "shipped").sum()),
            processing_orders=pd.NamedAgg(column="order_status", aggfunc=lambda s: (s == "processing").sum())
        )
        features = features.join(status_agg, how="left")
    else:
        status_cols = ["delivered_orders", "canceled_orders", "shipped_orders", "processing_orders"]
        for col in status_cols:
            features[col] = np.nan

    # --------------------------

    # --------------------------
    # Filter reviews to historical entries

        rev_product = rev_hist.merge(order_items[["order_id", "product_id"]], on="order_id", how="inner")

        rev_product_dedup = rev_product.drop_duplicates()

            positive_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc=lambda s: (s >= 4).sum()),
            negative_reviews=pd.NamedAgg(column="review_score", aggfunc=lambda s: (s <= 2).sum())
        )
        features = features.join(review_agg, how="left")
    else:
        rev_cols = ["total_reviews", "avg_review_score", "positive_reviews", "negative_reviews"]
        for col in rev_cols:
            features[col] = np.nan

    # --------------------------
    # 5. Payment Aggregates (purchase behavior metrics)
    # --------------------------
    # Filter payments to historical entries
    pay_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()
    if not pay_hist.empty and not oi_hist.empty:
        # Aggregate payment data per order first
        order_payment_agg = pay_hist.groupby("order_id").agg(
            total_order_payment=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_value", aggfunc="sum"),
            avg_payment_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_installments", aggfunc="mean"),
            num_payment_methods=pd.NamedAgg(column="payment_type", aggfunc="nunique")
        ).reset_index()
        # Link to products via order_items
        pay_product = oi_hist[["order_id", "product_id"]].merge(order_payment_agg, on="order_id", how="inner")
        # Deduplicate to avoid multiple entries for same order-product pair
        pay_product_dedup = pay_product.drop_duplicates()
        payment_agg = pay_product_dedup.groupby("product_id").agg(
            avg_order_total_value=pd.NamedAgg(column="total_order_payment", aggfunc="mean"),
            avg_installments=pd.NamedAgg(column="avg_payment_installments", aggfunc="mean"),
            avg_payment_methods=pd.NamedAgg(column="num_payment_methods", aggfunc="mean")
        )
        features = features.join(payment_agg, how="left")
    else:
        pay_cols = ["avg_order_total_value", "avg_installments", "avg_payment_methods"]
        for col in pay_cols:
            features[col] = np.nan

    # --------------------------
    # 6. Recency & Velocity Metrics (time-based behavior)
    # --------------------------
    if not oi_hist.empty:
        # Recency: days since last sale
        last_sale = oi_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max().reset_index(name="last_sale_ts")
        last_sale = last_sale.set_index("product_id")
        last_sale["days_since_last_sale"] = (seed_time - last_sale["last_sale_ts"]).dt.days
        recency_features = last_sale[["days_since_last_sale"]]

        # Velocity: days on sale, units sold per day
        product_lifecycle = oi_hist.groupby("product_id").agg(

        product_lifecycle["days_on_sale"] = product_lifecycle["days_on_sale"].replace(0, 1)  # Avoid division by zero
        product_lifecycle["units_per_day"] = product_lifecycle["total_units"] / product_lifecycle["days_on_sale"]
        velocity_features = product_lifecycle[["days_on_sale", "units_per_day"]]

        # Merge with base features
        features = features.join(recency_features, how="left")
        features = features.join(velocity_features, how="left")
    else:
        # Initialize empty columns if no historical data

        for col in time_cols:

        "days_on_sale", "units_per_day",
        "avg_review_score"
    ]
    recency_col = "days_since_last_sale"

    # Fill count features with 0 (no events)
    for col in count_features:
        if col in features.columns:

    # Fill numeric features with 0.0 (no data)
    for col in numeric_features:
        if col in features.columns:
            features[col] = features[col].fillna(0.0).astype(np.float64)

    # Fill recency: never sold → very large value (out of dataset time range)
    if recency_col in features.columns:
        max_recency = 100000
        features[recency_col] = features[recency_col].fillna(max_recency).astype(np.int64)

    # 8. Final Validation: Ensure index matches input entity_ids exactly

import numpy as np
def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Unpack database tables
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    # Define time windows for historical aggregations
    time_windows = [
        ("30d", pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("365d", pd.Timedelta(days=365)),
        ("alltime", None)  # All events before seed_time
    ]
    # Initialize base DataFrame with target entity IDs
    base = pd.DataFrame(index=entity_ids)
    base.index.name = "product_id"
    feature_dfs = []
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Process Order Items + Orders Data
    # --------------------------
    # Filter order items to relevant products and pre-seed_time events
    oi_filtered = order_items[
        (order_items["product_id"].isin(entity_ids)) &
        (order_items["ts"] < seed_time)
    ].copy()
    # Compute total item value once for reusability
    oi_filtered["total_value"] = oi_filtered["price"] + oi_filtered["freight_value"]
    # Merge with orders to get fulfillment and status data
    orders_subset = orders[[
        "order_id", "order_status", "order_approved_at",
        "order_delivered_carrier_date", "order_delivered_customer_date",
        "order_estimated_delivery_date"
    ]]
    oi_with_orders = pd.merge(
        oi_filtered,
        orders_subset,
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )
    # Compute derived time-based features (in hours/days for readability)
    oi_with_orders["approval_time_hours"] = (
        oi_with_orders["order_approved_at"] - oi_with_orders["ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / 3600
    oi_with_orders["ship_time_days"] = (
        oi_with_orders["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - oi_with_orders["ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    oi_with_orders["delivery_time_days"] = (
        oi_with_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] - oi_with_orders["ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    oi_with_orders["delivery_delay_days"] = (
        oi_with_orders["order_delivered_customer_date"] - oi_with_orders["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    # Binary flag features
    oi_with_orders["is_delivered"] = (oi_with_orders["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)
    oi_with_orders["is_late"] = (oi_with_orders["delivery_delay_days"] > 0).fillna(0).astype(int)
    # Aggregate features per time window
    for window_name, window_delta in time_windows:
        # Filter events to current window
        if window_delta is not None:
            start_time = seed_time - window_delta
            window_mask = oi_with_orders["ts"] >= start_time
        else:
            window_mask = pd.Series(True, index=oi_with_orders.index)
        window_data = oi_with_orders[window_mask]
        # Define aggregation rules
        agg_rules = {
            "order_item_id": ["count"],  # Units sold
            "price": ["sum", "mean", "median", "min", "max", "std"],
            "freight_value": ["sum", "mean", "median", "std"],
            "total_value": ["sum", "mean", "median", "std"],
            "approval_time_hours": ["mean", "median", "max", "std"],
            "ship_time_days": ["mean", "median", "max", "std"],
            "delivery_time_days": ["mean", "median", "max", "std"],
            "delivery_delay_days": ["mean", "median", "max", "std"],
            "is_delivered": ["sum", "mean"],  # Count and share of delivered orders
            "is_late": ["sum", "mean"]  # Count and share of late deliveries
        }
        # Compute aggregations
        agg_df = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_rules)
        # Flatten multi-level column names
        agg_df.columns = [
            f"{col[0]}_{col[1]}" if col[1] else col[0]
            for col in agg_df.columns
        ]
        # Add window prefix to column names
        agg_df = agg_df.rename(columns={
            col: f"{window_name}_{col}" for col in agg_df.columns
        })
        feature_dfs.append(agg_df)
    # Add recency features (time since first/last sale)
    first_last_sale = oi_filtered.groupby("product_id")["ts"].agg(["min", "max"]).reset_index()
    first_last_sale.columns = ["product_id", "first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"]
    first_last_sale["days_since_first_sale"] = (
        seed_time - first_last_sale["first_sale_ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    first_last_sale["days_since_last_sale"] = (
        seed_time - first_last_sale["last_sale_ts"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)
    first_last_sale = first_last_sale.set_index("product_id").drop(columns=["first_sale_ts", "last_sale_ts"])
    feature_dfs.append(first_last_sale)
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Process Seller Features
    # --------------------------
    # Aggregate seller metrics per product
    seller_product = oi_filtered[["product_id", "seller_id", "order_item_id"]].copy()
    seller_units = seller_product.groupby(["product_id", "seller_id"])["order_item_id"].count().reset_index(name="seller_units")
    product_seller_agg = seller_units.groupby("product_id").agg(
        n_unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
        max_seller_units=("seller_units", "max"),
        total_units=("seller_units", "sum")
    )
    # Compute top seller market share
    product_seller_agg["top_seller_share"] = (
        product_seller_agg["max_seller_units"] /
        product_seller_agg["total_units"].replace(0, np.nan)
    ).fillna(0)
    # Drop redundant total_units (already present in order item aggregations)
    product_seller_agg = product_seller_agg.drop(columns=["total_units"])
    feature_dfs.append(product_seller_agg)
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Process Review Data
    # --------------------------
    # Filter reviews to pre-seed_time events
    reviews_filtered = reviews[
        (reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time)
    ][[
        "order_id", "review_score", "review_comment_title",
        "review_comment_message", "review_creation_date"
    ]].copy()
    # Link reviews to products via order ID
    reviews_with_product = pd.merge(
        reviews_filtered,
        oi_filtered[["order_id", "product_id"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="inner"
    )
    # Binary flag features for comments
    reviews_with_product["has_comment_title"] = (~reviews_with_product["review_comment_title"].isna()).astype(int)
    reviews_with_product["has_comment_message"] = (~reviews_with_product["review_comment_message"].isna()).astype(int)
    reviews_with_product["has_any_comment"] = (
        reviews_with_product["has_comment_title"] | reviews_with_product["has_comment_message"]
    ).astype(int)
    # Aggregate review features per time window
    for window_name, window_delta in time_windows:
        if window_delta is not None:
            start_time = seed_time - window_delta
            window_mask = reviews_with_product["review_creation_date"] >= start_time
        else:
            window_mask = pd.Series(True, index=reviews_with_product.index)
        window_reviews = reviews_with_product[window_mask]
        # Define aggregation rules
        review_agg = window_reviews.groupby("product_id").agg(
            n_reviews=("review_score", "count"),
            avg_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
            med_review_score=("review_score", "median"),
            min_review_score=("review_score", "min"),

    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"]
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]
    
    # --------------------------
    # 1. Filter all tables to events STRICTLY before seed_time (no future data)
    # --------------------------
    # Filter order_items: only items from orders purchased before seed_time
    oi_valid = order_items[order_items['ts'] < seed_time].copy()
    # Filter reviews: only reviews created before seed_time
    reviews_valid = reviews[reviews['review_creation_date'] < seed_time].copy()
    # Filter payments: only payments processed before seed_time
    payments_valid = payments[payments['ts'] < seed_time].copy()
    # Filter orders: only orders purchased before seed_time (for status metrics)
    orders_valid = orders[orders['order_purchase_timestamp'] < seed_time].copy()
    
    # --------------------------
    # 2. Prepare time window features for rolling aggregates
    # --------------------------
    # Define time windows relative to seed_time
    time_windows = {
        '30d': pd.Timedelta(days=30),
        '90d': pd.Timedelta(days=90),
        '365d': pd.Timedelta(days=365)
    }
    # Calculate time from purchase to seed_time for window filtering
    oi_valid['time_to_seed'] = seed_time - oi_valid['ts']
    # Create boolean flags for each time window
    for window_name, window_delta in time_windows.items():
        oi_valid[f'in_{window_name}'] = oi_valid['time_to_seed'] <= window_delta
    
    # --------------------------
    # 3. Aggregate core order_items features (all-time + windowed)
    # --------------------------
    # All-time aggregates (all events before seed_time)
    all_time_agg = oi_valid.groupby('product_id').agg(
        total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
        total_units=('order_item_id', 'count'),
        avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
        std_price=('price', 'std'),
        min_price=('price', 'min'),
        max_price=('price', 'max'),
        total_revenue=('price', 'sum'),
        avg_freight=('freight_value', 'mean'),
        total_freight=('freight_value', 'sum'),
        num_unique_sellers=('seller_id', 'nunique'),
        first_purchase_age=('time_to_seed', 'max'),
        last_purchase_age=('time_to_seed', 'min')
    ).add_prefix('all_')
    
    # Windowed aggregates (30d, 90d, 365d)
    windowed_aggs = []
    for window_name in time_windows.keys():
        # Filter to items in current time window
        window_items = oi_valid[oi_valid[f'in_{window_name}']]
        if window_items.empty:
            # Create empty placeholder with correct index
            agg_df = pd.DataFrame(index=oi_valid['product_id'].unique())
            agg_df[f'{window_name}_total_orders'] = 0
            agg_df[f'{window_name}_total_units'] = 0
            agg_df[f'{window_name}_avg_price'] = np.nan
            agg_df[f'{window_name}_total_revenue'] = 0
            agg_df[f'{window_name}_share_of_all_orders'] = 0
        else:
            # Aggregate metrics for current window
            agg_df = window_items.groupby('product_id').agg(
                total_orders=('order_id', 'nunique'),
                total_units=('order_item_id', 'count'),
                avg_price=('price', 'mean'),
                total_revenue=('price', 'sum')
            ).add_prefix(f'{window_name}_')
            # Add share of all-time orders in current window (trend indicator)
            agg_df = agg_df.join(all_time_agg[['all_total_orders']], how='left')
            agg_df[f'{window_name}_share_of_all_orders'] = (
                agg_df[f'{window_name}_total_orders'] / agg_df['all_total_orders'].replace(0, np.nan)
            )
            agg_df.drop(columns=['all_total_orders'], inplace=True)
        windowed_aggs.append(agg_df)
    
    # Combine all order_items features
    core_features = all_time_agg.join(windowed_aggs, how='outer')
    
    # --------------------------
    # 4. Add order fulfillment status features
    # --------------------------
    # Link products to order status (avoid double-counting same order-product pairs)
    order_product_pairs = oi_valid[['order_id', 'product_id']].drop_duplicates()
    order_status_links = order_product_pairs.merge(
        orders_valid[['order_id', 'order_status']],
        on='order_id',
        how='left'
    )
    # Pivot to count per order status
    status_counts = order_status_links.groupby(['product_id', 'order_status']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
    status_counts = status_counts.add_prefix('status_count_')
    # Add percentage of successfully delivered orders (key fulfillment metric)
    if 'status_count_delivered' in status_counts.columns:
        status_counts['pct_delivered'] = (
            status_counts['status_count_delivered'] / status_counts.sum(axis=1).replace(0, np.nan)
        )
    else:
        status_counts['pct_delivered'] = 0
    
    # Merge status features with core features
    all_features = core_features.join(status_counts, how='outer')
    
    # --------------------------
    # 5. Add customer review features (sentiment metrics)
    # --------------------------
    # Link reviews to products (assign order-level reviews to all products in order)
    product_review_links = order_product_pairs.merge(
        reviews_valid[['order_id', 'review_score']],
        on='order_id',
        how='inner'
    )
    # Aggregate review metrics
    review_agg = product_review_links.groupby('product_id').agg(
        avg_review_score=('review_score', 'mean'),
        std_review_score=('review_score', 'std'),
        num_reviews=('review_score', 'count'),
        pct_5star_reviews=('review_score', lambda x: (x == 5).mean()),
        pct_1star_reviews=('review_score', lambda x: (x == 1).mean())
    )
    
    # Merge review features
    all_features = all_features.join(review_agg, how='outer')
    
    # --------------------------
    # 6. Add payment behavior features
    # --------------------------
    # Aggregate payment metrics per order first
    order_payment_agg = payments_valid.groupby('order_id').agg(
        total_order_payment=('payment_value', 'sum'),
        num_payment_steps=('payment_sequential', 'nunique'),
        avg_installments=('payment_installments', 'mean')
    )
    # Link payments to products
    product_payment_links = order_product_pairs.merge(
        order_payment_agg,
        on='order_id',
        how='inner'
    )
    # Aggregate payment metrics per product
    payment_agg = product_payment_links.groupby('product_id').agg(
        avg_order_total=('total_order_payment', 'mean'),
        total_payment_volume=('total_order_payment', 'sum'),
        avg_payment_steps=('num_payment_steps', 'mean'),
        avg_payment_installments=('avg_installments', 'mean')
    )
    
    # Merge payment features
    all_features = all_features.join(payment_agg, how='outer')
